ko.title: 전기 요금의 일부가 이제 AI 비용이 되었습니다: 미국의 데이터 센터 붐으로 인한 가격 결정 경매의 내막

segments.src: Most people will never read a capacity auction report.
segments.tr: 대부분의 사람들은 용량 경매 보고서를 읽지 않을 것입니다.

segments.src: But if you live in one of the 13 states or the District of Columbia served by the PJM Interconnection — roughly 65 million people, from Chicago to Newark to Richmond — one line in that report has more influence over your next electricity bill than almost anything happening in your own house.
segments.tr: 하지만 PJM Interconnection이 서비스하는 13개 주 또는 컬럼비아 특별구에 거주하는 약 6,500만 명의 사람들(시카고에서 뉴어크, 리치먼드까지)에게는, 그 보고서의 한 줄이 여러분의 다음 전기 요금에 여러분의 집에서 일어나는 그 어떤 일보다 더 큰 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: That line is the clearing price.
segments.tr: 그 한 줄이 바로 '낙찰가(clearing price)'입니다.

segments.src: For the delivery year that runs June 1, 2026 through May 31, 2027, it came in at **$329.17 per megawatt-day** — the effective ceiling allowed in the auction.
segments.tr: 2026년 6월 1일부터 2027년 5월 31일까지의 인도분으로, 낙찰가는 **메가와트-일당 $329.17**로 결정되었습니다. 이는 경매에서 허용된 실질적인 상한선이었습니다.

segments.src: Two delivery years earlier, the comparable price was **$28.92**.
segments.tr: 2년 전의 동일한 가격은 **$28.92**였습니다.

segments.src: That is not a typo, and it is not inflation.
segments.tr: 이는 오타가 아니며, 인플레이션 때문도 아닙니다.

segments.src: It is the price of promising that the lights stay on in a grid where demand has started growing again after roughly two decades of sitting flat — and where the fastest-growing single category of new demand is the data center.
segments.tr: 이는 약 20년 동안 정체되었던 수요가 다시 성장하기 시작한 그리드에서, 그리고 새로운 수요의 가장 빠르게 성장하는 단일 카테고리가 데이터 센터인 상황에서 전등이 계속 켜져 있도록 보장하는 가격입니다.

segments.src: ## The three numbers that tell the story
segments.tr: ## 이야기를 들려주는 세 가지 숫자

segments.src: | Delivery year | RTO-wide clearing price | Approximate total capacity cost |
segments.tr: | 인도 연도 | RTO 전역 낙찰가 | 대략적인 총 용량 비용 |

segments.src: | 2026 / 2027 | $329.17 per MW-day (at the cap) | ~$16.1 billion |
The 2026/27 auction, whose results PJM published in late July 2025, secured roughly 134,300 megawatts of capacity — a reserve margin somewhere near 19%, comfortably above the target.
segments.tr: PJM이 2025년 7월 말에 발표한 2026/27 경매 결과, 약 134,300메가와트의 용량이 확보되었습니다. 이는 예비율이 약 19%로, 목표치를 충분히 상회하는 수준입니다.

segments.src: In other words, the system did not come up short.
segments.tr: 다시 말해, 시스템에 부족함이 있었던 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: It simply became far more expensive to keep it that way.
segments.tr: 단지 그 상태를 유지하는 비용이 훨씬 더 비싸졌을 뿐입니다.

segments.src: ## What a capacity auction actually is
segments.tr: ## 용량 경매란 실제로 무엇인가

segments.src: This is the part that gets skipped, and it is the part that matters.
segments.tr: 이 부분이 생략되곤 하는데, 바로 이 부분이 중요합니다.

segments.src: Electricity markets pay for two different things.
segments.tr: 전력 시장은 두 가지 서로 다른 것에 대해 비용을 지불합니다.

segments.src: One is **energy** — the actual kilowatt-hours you use, priced more or less continuously.
segments.tr: 하나는 **에너지**입니다. 여러분이 실제로 사용하는 킬로와트시(kWh)이며, 가격이 거의 지속적으로 변동합니다.

segments.src: The other is **capacity** — a standing commitment from a power plant, a demand-response aggregator, or a battery to be available and deliver during the worst hours of the year: the January morning when everything is frozen, the July afternoon when everything is running.
segments.tr: 다른 하나는 **용량(capacity)**입니다. 발전소, 수요 반응 애그리게이터 또는 배터리가 연중 최악의 시간대(모든 것이 얼어붙은 1월의 아침이나 모든 것이 가동 중인 7월의 오후)에 가용 상태를 유지하고 전력을 공급할 수 있도록 하는 상시 약속입니다.

segments.src: PJM buys that commitment years ahead through the Base Residual Auction.
segments.tr: PJM은 기본 잔여 경매(Base Residual Auction)를 통해 수년 전부터 그 약속을 구매합니다.

segments.src: Suppliers offer to be available; PJM buys until it has enough to meet a reliability requirement; and — this is the crucial mechanic — **every cleared supplier gets paid the same clearing price**, set by the most expensive offer needed to fill the requirement.
segments.tr: 공급업체는 가용 상태를 제공하고, PJM은 신뢰성 요구 사항을 충족할 때까지 구매하며, 여기서 결정적인 메커니즘은 **낙찰된 모든 공급업체가 동일한 낙찰가를 지급받는다**는 점입니다. 이 가격은 요구 사항을 채우기 위해 필요한 가장 비싼 제안가로 설정됩니다.

segments.src: Not their own asking price.
segments.tr: 공급업체 자신의 요청 가격이 아닙니다.

segments.src: The market price.
segments.tr: 시장 가격입니다.

segments.src: That single design choice is why the number moves so violently.
segments.tr: 이 단일한 설계 선택이 숫자가 그렇게 격렬하게 변하는 이유입니다.

segments.src: When the requirement rises past the cheap, already-built supply and starts reaching into the expensive tail of the offer stack, the price for *everything* resets upward at once.
segments.tr: 요구 사항이 저렴하고 이미 구축된 공급량을 넘어 비싼 제안 스택의 꼬리 부분에 도달하기 시작하면, *모든 것*의 가격이 한꺼번에 위로 재설정됩니다.

segments.src: A modest increase in demand can produce a very immodest increase in cost.
segments.tr: 수요의 완만한 증가가 비용의 매우 급격한 증가를 초래할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Then the cost gets spread.
segments.tr: 그런 다음 그 비용이 분산됩니다.

segments.src: Utilities buy capacity on behalf of their customers and pass the charge through — showing up in the supply or generation portion of your bill, in your state's price-to-compare, or in a competitive supplier's rate.
segments.tr: 유틸리티 회사는 고객을 대신해 용량을 구매하고 그 비용을 전가하며, 이는 여러분의 고지서의 공급 또는 발전 부분, 주의 가격 비교 항목, 또는 경쟁 공급업체의 요금에 나타납니다.

segments.src: You never see a line item called "capacity auction."
segments.tr: 고지서에 "용량 경매"라는 항목은 절대 보이지 않습니다.

segments.src: You just see a bigger number.
segments.tr: 그저 더 큰 숫자가 보일 뿐입니다.

segments.src: ## Why the price hit the ceiling
segments.tr: ## 가격이 상한선에 도달한 이유

segments.src: Three pressures arrived at the same time.
segments.tr: 세 가지 압박이 동시에 닥쳤습니다.

segments.src: **Supply left.** Coal and older oil- and gas-fired units have been retiring on economics, age, and environmental compliance schedules.
segments.tr: **공급 감소.** 석탄 및 오래된 석유 및 가스 발전소들이 경제성, 노후화 및 환경 규제 일정에 따라 퇴역하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Once a plant deactivates, its capacity stops showing up in the auction.
segments.tr: 발전소가 가동을 중단하면, 그 용량은 경매에 더 이상 나타나지 않습니다.

segments.src: **Replacement is slow.** New solar, wind, storage, and gas projects have to clear interconnection studies, permitting, local approval, financing, and equipment orders.
segments.tr: **교체 속도가 느림.** 새로운 태양광, 풍력, 저장 장치 및 가스 프로젝트는 상호 연결 연구, 허가, 지역 승인, 자금 조달 및 장비 주문을 거쳐야 합니다.

segments.src: PJM's queue holds a very large volume of proposed projects; the constraint is not developer interest but the pace of study, construction, and delivery.
segments.tr: PJM의 대기열에는 제안된 프로젝트의 양이 매우 많지만, 제약 사항은 개발자의 관심이 아니라 연구, 건설 및 인도의 속도입니다.

segments.src: Heavy-duty gas turbines in particular are effectively sold out well into the next decade, with order backlogs at the handful of firms that build them.
segments.tr: 특히 고성능 가스 터빈은 다음 10년까지 사실상 매진 상태이며, 이를 제작하는 소수의 기업에 주문이 밀려 있습니다.

segments.src: **Demand turned upward.** After years of flat load, PJM's forecasts now show substantial peak growth through 2030 — the sharpest revision the region has seen in a generation.
segments.tr: **수요 증가.** 수년간의 정체된 부하 이후, PJM의 예측은 이제 2030년까지 상당한 피크 성장세를 보이고 있습니다. 이는 이 지역에서 한 세대 만에 본 가장 급격한 수정치입니다.

segments.src: Electrification contributes.
segments.tr: 전기화가 기여합니다.

segments.src: Manufacturing contributes.
segments.tr: 제조업이 기여합니다.

segments.src: But the category driving the revision is large data-center load, concentrated heavily in Northern Virginia and spreading into Ohio, Pennsylvania, Indiana, and Maryland.
segments.tr: 하지만 이 수정을 주도하는 카테고리는 대규모 데이터 센터 부하이며, 이는 북버지니아에 집중되어 있고 오하이오, 펜실베이니아, 인디애나, 메릴랜드로 확산되고 있습니다.

segments.src: Retirements plus slow replacement plus rising demand equals a tighter requirement met by a more expensive offer stack.
segments.tr: 퇴역과 느린 교체, 그리고 증가하는 수요가 합쳐져 더 비싼 제안 스택으로 충족되어야 하는 더 타이트한 요구 사항이 되었습니다.

segments.src: The auction did what it was designed to do: it printed a very loud price signal.
segments.tr: 경매는 설계된 대로 작동했습니다. 즉, 매우 강력한 가격 신호를 보낸 것입니다.

segments.src: ## How much of this is really AI?
segments.tr: ## 이 중 얼마나 많은 부분이 정말로 AI 때문인가?

segments.src: Here the honest answer requires care, because this is where public discussion tends to get sloppy.
segments.tr: 여기서 정직한 답변을 내놓으려면 주의가 필요합니다. 왜냐하면 이 부분이 대중의 논의가 느슨해지는 경향이 있기 때문입니다.

segments.src: PJM's independent market monitor, which analyzes the auction separately from PJM itself, has published assessments attributing the large majority of the recent price increases to growth in large load — data centers above all.
segments.tr: PJM 자체와 별개로 경매를 분석하는 PJM의 독립 시장 감시자는 최근의 가격 상승의 대부분을 대규모 부하 성장, 특히 데이터 센터의 성장으로 돌리는 평가를 발표했습니다.

segments.src: Under that analysis, if data-center demand growth were removed from the reliability requirement, the clearing price would be dramatically lower.
segments.tr: 그 분석에 따르면, 만약 데이터 센터의 수요 성장이 신뢰성 요구 사항에서 제거된다면, 낙찰가는 극적으로 낮아질 것입니다.

segments.src: That is a modeled counterfactual, not a measurement, and reasonable analysts dispute the exact share.
segments.tr: 이는 모델링된 가상 상황(counterfactual)이지 측정값이 아니며, 합리적인 분석가들은 정확한 비중을 두고 논쟁합니다.

segments.src: But the direction is not seriously contested: data centers are the dominant swing factor.
segments.tr: 하지만 방향성은 심각하게 논쟁의 여지가 없습니다. 데이터 센터가 지배적인 변동 요인이라는 점입니다.

segments.src: Two fair counterpoints belong alongside it.
segments.tr: 두 가지 공정한 반론이 함께 제시되어야 합니다.

segments.src: First, data centers do pay.
segments.tr: 첫째, 데이터 센터도 비용을 지불합니다.

segments.src: They pay retail tariffs, they pay capacity charges proportional to their contribution to peak, and in many cases they pay for interconnection upgrades directly.
segments.tr: 그들은 소매 요금을 지불하고, 피크 시간대 기여도에 비례하는 용량 요금을 지불하며, 많은 경우 상호 연결 업그레이드 비용을 직접 지불합니다.

segments.src: They are not receiving free electricity.
segments.tr: 그들이 공짜 전기를 받는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: Second, the grievance is about **allocation and risk**, not theft.
segments.tr: 둘째, 불만은 도둑질이 아니라 **배분과 리스크**에 관한 것입니다.

segments.src: When a uniform clearing price resets because one customer class is adding gigawatts, every other customer — the household, the school district, the machine shop — pays the new price on their existing consumption too.
segments.tr: 한 고객 클래스가 기가와트 단위의 전력을 추가할 때 균일 낙찰가가 재설정되면, 다른 모든 고객(가정, 교육구, 기계 공장) 역시 기존 소비량에 대해 새로운 가격을 지불하게 됩니다.

segments.src: The build-out's cost is socialized across the whole footprint, while the revenue from the build-out is not.
segments.tr: 구축 비용은 전체 지역에 사회화되는 반면, 구축으로 인한 수익은 그렇지 않습니다.

segments.src: That asymmetry, rather than any single company's behavior, is the actual policy problem.
segments.tr: 특정 회사의 행동보다는 이러한 비대칭성이 실제 정책적 문제입니다.

segments.src: ## What this looks like on your bill
segments.tr: ## 고지서에 어떻게 나타나는가

segments.src: PJM's own estimate for the 2026/27 result was an increase in the range of roughly **1.5% to 5% on typical residential bills**, varying by zone — layered on top of the considerably larger increase already working its way through from the prior auction.
segments.tr: PJM이 추정한 2026/27 결과로 인한 일반적인 주거용 고지서의 증가분은 구역별로 차이가 있지만 대략 **1.5%에서 5%** 범위였습니다. 이는 이전 경매에서 이미 적용되고 있는 상당히 더 큰 증가분 위에 추가로 얹어지는 것입니다.

segments.src: Several things make the lived experience messier than that range suggests:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 요인으로 인해 실제 경험은 그 범위보다 더 복잡합니다.

segments.src: - **Timing varies.** States and utilities procure default supply on different cycles, so the same auction lands in different months and different chunks depending on where you live.
segments.tr: - **타이밍의 차이.** 주와 유틸리티 회사는 서로 다른 주기로 기본 공급량을 조달하므로, 거주 지역에 따라 동일한 경매 결과가 서로 다른 달에, 서로 다른 덩어리로 반영됩니다.

segments.src: - **Zones differ.** Transmission constraints mean some areas clear above the RTO-wide price, and those customers absorb more.
segments.tr: - **구역의 차이.** 송전 제약으로 인해 일부 지역은 RTO 전역 가격보다 높게 낙찰되며, 해당 고객들이 더 많은 비용을 부담합니다.

segments.src: - **Capacity is only part of the bill.** Transmission investment, distribution rates, and fuel costs move on their own schedules and can pull the total in the same direction at the same time.
segments.tr: - **용량은 고지서의 일부일 뿐입니다.** 송전 투자, 배전 요금 및 연료비는 자체적인 일정에 따라 변동하며, 동시에 전체 금액을 같은 방향으로 끌어올릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: If you want your actual number rather than an average, the practical path is your utility's rate filing or price-to-compare notice at your state public utility commission — that document shows the supply cost being passed through, in your zone, for your service class.
segments.tr: 평균치가 아닌 실제 숫자를 알고 싶다면, 유틸리티 회사의 요금 신청서나 주 공공 유틸리티 위원회의 가격 비교 통지서를 확인하는 것이 실질적인 방법입니다. 해당 문서에는 여러분의 구역과 서비스 클래스에 대해 전가되는 공급 비용이 표시되어 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Who is trying to fix it, and how
segments.tr: ## 누가 어떻게 해결하려 하는가

segments.src: The response has been unusually fast by energy-regulation standards.
segments.tr: 에너지 규제 표준으로는 이례적으로 빠른 대응이 있었습니다.

segments.src: **A price collar.** After Pennsylvania's governor challenged the auction rules at the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, PJM and the state reached a settlement that FERC approved: a floor and a ceiling on the clearing price for the 2026/27 and 2027/28 auctions.
segments.tr: **가격 칼라(price collar).** 펜실베이니아 주지사가 연방 에너지 규제 위원회(FERC)에 경매 규칙에 이의를 제기한 후, PJM과 주는 FERC가 승인한 합의에 도달했습니다. 2026/27 및 2027/28 경매의 낙찰가에 하한선과 상한선을 두는 것입니다.

segments.src: The ceiling is precisely why 2026/27 stopped at $329.17.
segments.tr: 상한선이 있었기에 2026/27 가격이 $329.17에서 멈춘 것입니다.

segments.src: Absent that cap, the price would very likely have gone higher — a detail worth remembering when reading the number.
segments.tr: 그 상한선이 없었다면 가격은 매우 가능성 높게 더 올라갔을 것입니다. 이는 숫자를 읽을 때 기억해야 할 세부 사항입니다.

segments.src: **Faster interconnection for what's needed.** PJM created a fast-track pathway to move a limited slate of projects that add reliable capacity quickly, alongside broader reforms to its interconnection process.
segments.tr: **필요한 시설의 빠른 상호 연결.** PJM은 상호 연결 프로세스의 광범위한 개혁과 함께, 신뢰할 수 있는 용량을 빠르게 추가하는 제한된 프로젝트 목록을 위한 패스트트랙 경로를 만들었습니다.

segments.src: **Making large loads carry their own weight.** This is the most consequential front.
segments.tr: **대규모 부하가 스스로의 몫을 부담하게 함.** 이것이 가장 영향력 있는 전선입니다.

segments.src: Regulators and utilities across the footprint are reworking how very large customers are treated: minimum-demand contracts so a data center pays for most of the capacity it reserves whether or not it uses it, separate rate classes for large loads, collateral and exit provisions, and rules for "bring your own generation" or co-located supply arrangements.
segments.tr: 전 지역의 규제 기관과 유틸리티 회사는 매우 큰 고객을 어떻게 처리할지 재작업하고 있습니다. 데이터 센터가 사용 여부와 관계없이 예약한 용량의 대부분을 지불하도록 하는 최소 수요 계약, 대규모 부하를 위한 별도의 요금 클래스, 담보 및 종료 조항, 그리고 "자체 발전 시설 도입(bring your own generation)" 또는 공동 배치 공급 계약에 대한 규칙을 마련하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Ohio approved a large-load framework along these lines, and similar proceedings have opened elsewhere.
segments.tr: 오하이오는 이러한 방향으로 대규모 부하 프레임워크를 승인했으며, 다른 지역에서도 유사한 절차가 시작되었습니다.

segments.src: FERC has taken up the co-location question for PJM specifically.
segments.tr: FERC는 특히 PJM을 위한 공동 배치 문제를 다루고 있습니다.

segments.src: **Demand flexibility.** Because the requirement is driven by a handful of peak hours, a data center willing to curtail or shift to on-site generation during those hours reduces the requirement itself.
segments.tr: **수요 유연성.** 요구 사항은 소수의 피크 시간대에 의해 결정되므로, 그 시간대에 전력을 제한하거나 온사이트 발전으로 전환하려는 데이터 센터는 요구 사항 자체를 줄여줍니다.

segments.src: Several operators have signaled willingness; turning that into enforceable, verifiable commitments is the unfinished work.
segments.tr: 여러 운영자가 의향을 밝혔으며, 이를 집행 가능하고 검증 가능한 약속으로 바꾸는 것이 아직 남은 과제입니다.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 앞으로 지켜봐야 할 것

segments.src: - **Subsequent auction results.** Each new Base Residual Auction tests whether new supply and demand-side commitments are arriving fast enough to pull the price off the ceiling — and what happens when the collar's coverage ends.
segments.tr: - **이후의 경매 결과.** 새로운 기본 잔여 경매는 새로운 공급 및 수요 측면의 약속이 가격을 상한선에서 끌어내릴 만큼 충분히 빠르게 도착하고 있는지 테스트합니다. 또한 칼라의 적용 범위가 끝날 때 어떤 일이 일어날지 보여줄 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Whether large-load tariffs actually bind.** A rate class only shifts cost if its minimum-take and collateral terms survive negotiation and litigation intact.
segments.tr: - **대규모 부하 요금제가 실제로 구속력을 갖는지 여부.** 요금 클래스는 최소 수취량과 담보 조건이 협상과 소송을 통해 그대로 유지되어야만 비용을 전가할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Real megawatts, not announcements.** Announced generation projects are cheap; steel in the ground and turbines delivered are what changes an auction outcome.
segments.tr: - **발표가 아닌 실제 메가와트.** 발표된 발전 프로젝트는 저렴합니다. 실제로 땅에 철골을 세우고 터빈이 인도되는 것이 경매 결과에 변화를 줍니다.

segments.src: - **Whether load forecasts hold.** Some share of the interconnection requests in the pipeline is speculative or duplicated across utilities. If forecast demand is revised down, the requirement — and the price — follows.
segments.tr: - **부하 예측이 유지되는지 여부.** 파이프라인에 있는 상호 연결 요청의 일부는 투기적이거나 유틸리티 간에 중복되어 있습니다. 예측 수요가 하향 조정되면 요구 사항과 가격이 그에 따라 낮아집니다.

segments.src: - **Political durability.** Rate increases of this size tend to outlast the technical debate. Legislative intervention in individual states is a live possibility.
segments.tr: - **정치적 내구성.** 이 정도 규모의 요금 인상은 기술적 논쟁을 넘어설 가능성이 큽니다. 개별 주에서의 입법적 개입 가능성이 열려 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The AI build-out has a price, and part of it is being paid through an obscure auction that most ratepayers have never heard of.
segments.tr: AI 구축에는 비용이 따르며, 그 일부는 대부분의 요금 납부자가 들어본 적도 없는 모호한 경매를 통해 지불되고 있습니다.

segments.src: There is nothing hidden or improper about the mechanism — the rules are public, the results are published, and the market is doing exactly what a uniform-clearing-price market does when demand outruns cheap supply.
segments.tr: 이 메커니즘에는 숨겨진 것이나 부적절한 것은 없습니다. 규칙은 공개되어 있고, 결과는 발표되며, 시장은 수요가 저렴한 공급을 앞지를 때 균일 낙찰가 시장이 하는 일을 정확히 수행하고 있습니다.

segments.src: What is genuinely unresolved is who should bear the cost.
segments.tr: 정말로 해결되지 않은 문제는 누가 그 비용을 부담해야 하는가 하는 점입니다.

segments.src: Right now the answer is largely "everyone on the system, in proportion to their existing usage."
segments.tr: 현재의 답은 대체로 "시스템의 모든 사람, 기존 사용량에 비례하여"입니다.

segments.src: Every reform currently in motion is an attempt to change that answer before the next several auctions lock it in.
segments.tr: 현재 진행 중인 모든 개혁은 다음 몇 번의 경매가 이를 확정 짓기 전에 그 답을 바꾸려는 시도입니다.

segments.src: *Figures in this article are drawn from PJM's published Base Residual Auction results, its independent market monitor's public analyses, and filings at FERC and state utility commissions.
segments.tr: *이 기사의 수치는 PJM의 발표된 기본 잔여 경매 결과, 독립 시장 감시자의 공개 분석, FERC 및 주 유틸리티 위원회의 신청서에서 가져왔습니다.

segments.src: Auction results and reform proceedings are updated regularly; for the current numbers, consult PJM's posted auction reports and your state commission's docket.
segments.tr: 경매 결과와 개혁 절차는 정기적으로 업데이트됩니다. 현재 수치를 확인하려면 PJM의 게시된 경매 보고서와 주 위원회의 기록을 참조하십시오.

segments.src: Bill impact ranges are estimates and will differ by utility, zone, and service class.
segments.tr: 요금 영향 범위는 추정치이며 유틸리티, 구역 및 서비스 클래스에 따라 다릅니다.

segments.src: This is general information, not investment or legal advice.*
segments.tr: 이는 일반적인 정보이며, 투자 또는 법률 자문이 아닙니다.*

zh.title: 你的电费单现在部分变成了 AI 账单：揭秘决定美国数据中心热潮价格的拍卖会

segments.src: Most people will never read a capacity auction report.
segments.tr: 大多数人永远不会阅读容量拍卖报告。

segments.src: But if you live in one of the 13 states or the District of Columbia served by the PJM Interconnection — roughly 65 million people, from Chicago to Newark to Richmond — one line in that report has more influence over your next electricity bill than almost anything happening in your own house.
segments.tr: 但如果你住在由 PJM Interconnection 服务的 13 个州或哥伦比亚特区之一 —— 大约 6500 万人，从芝加哥到纽瓦克再到里士满 —— 该报告中的一行文字对你下一张电费单的影响，比你家里发生的几乎任何事情都要大。

segments.src: That line is the clearing price.
segments.tr: 那一行就是出清价格（clearing price）。

segments.src: For the delivery year that runs June 1, 2026 through May 31, 2027, it came in at **$329.17 per megawatt-day** — the effective ceiling allowed in the auction.
segments.tr: 对于 2026 年 6 月 1 日至 2027 年 5 月 31 日的交付年度，该价格为 **每兆瓦-日 329.17 美元** —— 这是拍卖中允许的有效上限。

segments.src: Two delivery years earlier, the comparable price was **$28.92**.
segments.tr: 两个交付年度前，同类价格为 **28.92 美元**。

segments.src: That is not a typo, and it is not inflation.
segments.tr: 这不是笔误，也不是通货膨胀。

segments.src: It is the price of promising that the lights stay on in a grid where demand has started growing again after roughly two decades of sitting flat — and where the fastest-growing single category of new demand is the data center.
segments.tr: 这是在电网需求在经历了大约二十年的持平之后重新开始增长，且增长最快的新需求类别是数据中心的情况下，承诺保持电力供应的价格。

segments.src: ## The three numbers that tell the story
segments.tr: ## 讲述故事的三个数字

segments.src: | Delivery year | RTO-wide clearing price | Approximate total capacity cost |
segments.tr: | 交付年度 | RTO 全局出清价格 | 近似总容量成本 |

segments.src: | 2026 / 2027 | $329.17 per MW-day (at the cap) | ~$16.1 billion |
The 2026/27 auction, whose results PJM published in late July 2025, secured roughly 134,300 megawatts of capacity — a reserve margin somewhere near 19%, comfortably above the target.
segments.tr: PJM 在 2025 年 7 月下旬公布的 2026/27 拍卖结果显示，共获得了约 134,300 兆瓦的容量 —— 储备裕度在 19% 左右， comfortably 高于目标值。

segments.src: In other words, the system did not come up short.
segments.tr: 换句话说，系统并没有出现短缺。

segments.src: It simply became far more expensive to keep it that way.
segments.tr: 只是维持这种状态变得昂贵得多。

segments.src: ## What a capacity auction actually is
segments.tr: ## 什么是容量拍卖

segments.src: This is the part that gets skipped, and it is the part that matters.
segments.tr: 这是被跳过的部分，也是最关键的部分。

segments.src: Electricity markets pay for two different things.
segments.tr: 电力市场支付两项不同的费用。

segments.src: One is **energy** — the actual kilowatt-hours you use, priced more or less continuously.
segments.tr: 一项是 **能量（energy）** —— 你实际使用的千瓦时，价格大致是连续波动的。

segments.src: The other is **capacity** — a standing commitment from a power plant, a demand-response aggregator, or a battery to be available and deliver during the worst hours of the year: the January morning when everything is frozen, the July afternoon when everything is running.
segments.tr: 另一项是 **容量（capacity）** —— 电厂、需求响应聚合商或电池的长期承诺，确保在一年中最糟糕的时段（如所有设备冻结的 1 月早晨，或所有设备运行的 7 月下午）能够可用并供电。

segments.src: PJM buys that commitment years ahead through the Base Residual Auction.
segments.tr: PJM 通过基础剩余拍卖（Base Residual Auction）提前数年购买这种承诺。

segments.src: Suppliers offer to be available; PJM buys until it has enough to meet a reliability requirement; and — this is the crucial mechanic — **every cleared supplier gets paid the same clearing price**, set by the most expensive offer needed to fill the requirement.
segments.tr: 供应商提供可用性；PJM 购买直到满足可靠性要求；而且 —— 这是关键机制 —— **每个出清的供应商都获得相同的出清价格**，该价格由满足要求所需的最昂贵的报价决定。

segments.src: Not their own asking price.
segments.tr: 而不是他们自己的报价。

segments.src: The market price.
segments.tr: 而是市场价格。

segments.src: That single design choice is why the number moves so violently.
segments.tr: 这个单一的设计选择就是数字波动如此剧烈的原因。

segments.src: When the requirement rises past the cheap, already-built supply and starts reaching into the expensive tail of the offer stack, the price for *everything* resets upward at once.
segments.tr: 当需求超过廉价的既有供应，开始触及报价堆栈中昂贵的尾部时，*所有* 供应的价格会立即统一上调。

segments.src: A modest increase in demand can produce a very immodest increase in cost.
segments.tr: 需求的轻微增加可能会导致成本的剧烈增加。

segments.src: Then the cost gets spread.
segments.tr: 然后成本被分摊。

segments.src: Utilities buy capacity on behalf of their customers and pass the charge through — showing up in the supply or generation portion of your bill, in your state's price-to-compare, or in a competitive supplier's rate.
segments.tr: 公用事业公司代表客户购买容量，并将费用转嫁 —— 体现在你账单的供应或发电部分，在你所在州的对比价格中，或在竞争供应商的费率中。

segments.src: You never see a line item called "capacity auction."
segments.tr: 你永远不会在账单上看到名为“容量拍卖”的项目。

segments.src: You just see a bigger number.
segments.tr: 你只会看到一个更大的数字。

segments.src: ## Why the price hit the ceiling
segments.tr: ## 为什么价格触顶

segments.src: Three pressures arrived at the same time.
segments.tr: 三种压力同时到来。

segments.src: **Supply left.** Coal and older oil- and gas-fired units have been retiring on economics, age, and environmental compliance schedules.
segments.tr: **供应减少。** 煤电以及较旧的燃油和燃气机组由于经济性、年限和环保合规计划而陆续退役。

segments.src: Once a plant deactivates, its capacity stops showing up in the auction.
segments.tr: 一旦电厂停运，其容量就不再出现在拍卖中。

segments.src: **Replacement is slow.** New solar, wind, storage, and gas projects have to clear interconnection studies, permitting, local approval, financing, and equipment orders.
segments.tr: **替代速度缓慢。** 新的太阳能、风能、储能和天然气项目必须通过互连研究、许可、当地批准、融资和设备订单。

segments.src: PJM's queue holds a very large volume of proposed projects; the constraint is not developer interest but the pace of study, construction, and delivery.
segments.tr: PJM 的队列中持有大量拟议项目；限制因素不是开发商的兴趣，而是研究、建设和交付的速度。

segments.src: Heavy-duty gas turbines in particular are effectively sold out well into the next decade, with order backlogs at the handful of firms that build them.
segments.tr: 特别是重型燃气轮机，在接下来的十年中实际上已经售罄，少数几家制造公司的订单积压严重。

segments.src: **Demand turned upward.** After years of flat load, PJM's forecasts now show substantial peak growth through 2030 — the sharpest revision the region has seen in a generation.
segments.tr: **需求回升。** 在经历了多年的负荷持平后，PJM 的预测现在显示到 2030 年峰值将大幅增长 —— 这是该地区一代人以来见过的最剧烈的修正。

segments.src: Electrification contributes.
segments.tr: 电气化有所贡献。

segments.src: Manufacturing contributes.
segments.tr: 制造业有所贡献。

segments.src: But the category driving the revision is large data-center load, concentrated heavily in Northern Virginia and spreading into Ohio, Pennsylvania, Indiana, and Maryland.
segments.tr: 但驱动此次修正的主要类别是大型数据中心负荷，这些负荷高度集中在北弗吉尼亚州，并扩展到俄亥俄州、宾夕法尼亚州、印第安纳州和马里兰州。

segments.src: Retirements plus slow replacement plus rising demand equals a tighter requirement met by a more expensive offer stack.
segments.tr: 退役 + 缓慢替代 + 需求增长 = 更紧迫的需求，由更昂贵的报价堆栈满足。

segments.src: The auction did what it was designed to do: it printed a very loud price signal.
segments.tr: 拍卖会发挥了其设计的作用：它发出了一个非常强烈的价格信号。

segments.src: ## How much of this is really AI?
segments.tr: ## 其中有多少真正与 AI 有关？

segments.src: Here the honest answer requires care, because this is where public discussion tends to get sloppy.
segments.tr: 这里的诚实回答需要谨慎，因为这是公众讨论容易变得草率的地方。

segments.src: PJM's independent market monitor, which analyzes the auction separately from PJM itself, has published assessments attributing the large majority of the recent price increases to growth in large load — data centers above all.
segments.tr: PJM 的独立市场监督员（独立于 PJM 本身分析拍卖）发布的评估报告将近期价格上涨的大部分归因于大负荷的增长 —— 尤其是数据中心。

segments.src: Under that analysis, if data-center demand growth were removed from the reliability requirement, the clearing price would be dramatically lower.
segments.tr: 根据该分析，如果将数据中心的需求增长从可靠性要求中移除，出清价格将大幅降低。

segments.src: That is a modeled counterfactual, not a measurement, and reasonable analysts dispute the exact share.
segments.tr: 这是一个模拟的假设情况，而非实际测量，合理的分析师对具体份额存在争议。

segments.src: But the direction is not seriously contested: data centers are the dominant swing factor.
segments.tr: 但方向没有严重争议：数据中心是主导的波动因素。

segments.src: Two fair counterpoints belong alongside it.
segments.tr: 这里有两个公平的反论点。

segments.src: First, data centers do pay.
segments.tr: 首先，数据中心确实在付费。

segments.src: They pay retail tariffs, they pay capacity charges proportional to their contribution to peak, and in many cases they pay for interconnection upgrades directly.
segments.tr: 它们支付零售电价，支付与其对峰值贡献成比例的容量费，且在许多情况下直接支付互连升级费用。

segments.src: They are not receiving free electricity.
segments.tr: 它们并没有获得免费电力。

segments.src: Second, the grievance is about **allocation and risk**, not theft.
segments.tr: 其次，不满之处在于 **分配和风险**，而非盗窃。

segments.src: When a uniform clearing price resets because one customer class is adding gigawatts, every other customer — the household, the school district, the machine shop — pays the new price on their existing consumption too.
segments.tr: 当统一出清价格因为某一类客户增加吉瓦级需求而重置时，所有其他客户 —— 家庭、学区、机加工店 —— 在其现有消费上也要支付新价格。

segments.src: The build-out's cost is socialized across the whole footprint, while the revenue from the build-out is not.
segments.tr: 扩建成本在整个覆盖范围内社会化，而扩建带来的收入则不然。

segments.src: That asymmetry, rather than any single company's behavior, is the actual policy problem.
segments.tr: 这种不对称性，而非任何单一公司的行为，才是真正的政策问题。

segments.src: ## What this looks like on your bill
segments.tr: ## 这在你的账单上如何体现

segments.src: PJM's own estimate for the 2026/27 result was an increase in the range of roughly **1.5% to 5% on typical residential bills**, varying by zone — layered on top of the considerably larger increase already working its way through from the prior auction.
segments.tr: PJM 对 2026/27 结果的估计是，典型住宅账单将增加大约 **1.5% 到 5%**，具体取决于区域 —— 这是在之前拍卖已经产生的相当大增幅之上的叠加。

segments.src: Several things make the lived experience messier than that range suggests:
segments.tr: 有几件事使得实际体验比该范围显示的更复杂：

segments.src: - **Timing varies.** States and utilities procure default supply on different cycles, so the same auction lands in different months and different chunks depending on where you live.
segments.tr: - **时间不同。** 各州和公用事业公司在不同的周期采购默认供应，因此同一场拍卖在不同月份以不同份额落地，取决于你住在哪里。

segments.src: - **Zones differ.** Transmission constraints mean some areas clear above the RTO-wide price, and those customers absorb more.
segments.tr: - **区域不同。** 传输限制意味着某些地区的出清价格高于 RTO 全局价格，这些客户承担更多。

segments.src: - **Capacity is only part of the bill.** Transmission investment, distribution rates, and fuel costs move on their own schedules and can pull the total in the same direction at the same time.
segments.tr: - **容量仅是账单的一部分。** 传输投资、配电费率和燃料成本按自己的时间表变动，并可能在同一时间将总额推向同一方向。

segments.src: If you want your actual number rather than an average, the practical path is your utility's rate filing or price-to-compare notice at your state public utility commission — that document shows the supply cost being passed through, in your zone, for your service class.
segments.tr: 如果你想要实际数字而非平均值，实际路径是查看你公用事业公司的费率申报或在你州公共事业委员会的对比价格通知 —— 该文件显示了在你所在区域、针对你的服务类别所转嫁的供应成本。

segments.src: ## Who is trying to fix it, and how
segments.tr: ## 谁在尝试解决，以及如何解决

segments.src: The response has been unusually fast by energy-regulation standards.
segments.tr: 按照能源监管标准，响应速度异常之快。

segments.src: **A price collar.** After Pennsylvania's governor challenged the auction rules at the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, PJM and the state reached a settlement that FERC approved: a floor and a ceiling on the clearing price for the 2026/27 and 2027/28 auctions.
segments.tr: **价格区间（price collar）。** 在宾夕法尼亚州州长向联邦能源监管委员会（FERC）挑战拍卖规则后，PJM 和该州达成了一项被 FERC 批准的协议：为 2026/27 和 2027/28 拍卖的出清价格设定底线和上限。

segments.src: The ceiling is precisely why 2026/27 stopped at $329.17.
segments.tr: 上限正是 2026/27 价格停止在 329.17 美元的原因。

segments.src: Absent that cap, the price would very likely have gone higher — a detail worth remembering when reading the number.
segments.tr: 如果没有这个上限，价格极有可能更高 —— 在阅读该数字时，这是一个值得记住的细节。

segments.src: **Faster interconnection for what's needed.** PJM created a fast-track pathway to move a limited slate of projects that add reliable capacity quickly, alongside broader reforms to its interconnection process.
segments.tr: **针对需求加快互连。** PJM 创建了一条快速通道，以快速推进一小部分能够增加可靠容量的项目，同时对其互连流程进行广泛改革。

segments.src: **Making large loads carry their own weight.** This is the most consequential front.
segments.tr: **让大负荷承担自己的责任。** 这是最关键的阵地。

segments.src: Regulators and utilities across the footprint are reworking how very large customers are treated: minimum-demand contracts so a data center pays for most of the capacity it reserves whether or not it uses it, separate rate classes for large loads, collateral and exit provisions, and rules for "bring your own generation" or co-located supply arrangements.
segments.tr: 整个覆盖范围内的监管机构和公用事业公司正在重新制定对待超大型客户的方式：最低需求合同（使数据中心无论是否使用，都要为其预留的大部分容量付费）、针对大负荷的独立费率类别、抵押和退出条款，以及“自带发电”或共址供应安排的规则。

segments.src: Ohio approved a large-load framework along these lines, and similar proceedings have opened elsewhere.
segments.tr: 俄亥俄州批准了类似的大负荷框架，其他地方也开启了类似的程序。

segments.src: FERC has taken up the co-location question for PJM specifically.
segments.tr: FERC 专门针对 PJM 的共址问题进行了研究。

segments.src: **Demand flexibility.** Because the requirement is driven by a handful of peak hours, a data center willing to curtail or shift to on-site generation during those hours reduces the requirement itself.
segments.tr: **需求灵活性。** 因为需求是由少数几个峰值小时驱动的，如果数据中心愿意在这些小时内削减用电或转向现场发电，将降低需求本身。

segments.src: Several operators have signaled willingness; turning that into enforceable, verifiable commitments is the unfinished work.
segments.tr: 几家运营商已表示愿意；将其转化为可执行、可验证的承诺是尚未完成的工作。

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 接下来关注什么

segments.src: - **Subsequent auction results.** Each new Base Residual Auction tests whether new supply and demand-side commitments are arriving fast enough to pull the price off the ceiling — and what happens when the collar's coverage ends.
segments.tr: - **后续拍卖结果。** 每次新的基础剩余拍卖都将测试新供应和需求侧承诺是否足够快地到达，以将价格从上限拉下来 —— 以及当价格区间覆盖结束时会发生什么。

segments.src: - **Whether large-load tariffs actually bind.** A rate class only shifts cost if its minimum-take and collateral terms survive negotiation and litigation intact.
segments.tr: - **大负荷电价是否真正具有约束力。** 只有当最低消费和抵押条款在谈判和诉讼中保持完整时，费率类别才能转移成本。

segments.src: - **Real megawatts, not announcements.** Announced generation projects are cheap; steel in the ground and turbines delivered are what changes an auction outcome.
segments.tr: - **真实的兆瓦，而非公告。** 公告的发电项目很便宜；只有钢材入地和涡轮机交付才能改变拍卖结果。

segments.src: - **Whether load forecasts hold.** Some share of the interconnection requests in the pipeline is speculative or duplicated across utilities. If forecast demand is revised down, the requirement — and the price — follows.
segments.tr: - **负荷预测是否成立。** 管道中的部分互连请求是投机性的或在不同公用事业公司之间重复的。如果预测需求下调，需求量 —— 以及价格 —— 也会随之下降。

segments.src: - **Political durability.** Rate increases of this size tend to outlast the technical debate. Legislative intervention in individual states is a live possibility.
segments.tr: - **政治耐受度。** 如此规模的费率上涨往往会超出技术辩论的范围。各州立法机构的干预是一个现实的可能性。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: The AI build-out has a price, and part of it is being paid through an obscure auction that most ratepayers have never heard of.
segments.tr: AI 的扩建是有代价的，其中一部分是通过一个大多数电费缴纳者从未听说过的晦涩拍卖会支付的。

segments.src: There is nothing hidden or improper about the mechanism — the rules are public, the results are published, and the market is doing exactly what a uniform-clearing-price market does when demand outruns cheap supply.
segments.tr: 这种机制没有隐藏或不正当之处 —— 规则公开，结果公布，且市场在需求超过廉价供应时，完全按照统一出清价格市场的运作方式运行。

segments.src: What is genuinely unresolved is who should bear the cost.
segments.tr: 真正尚未解决的是谁应该承担成本。

segments.src: Right now the answer is largely "everyone on the system, in proportion to their existing usage."
segments.tr: 目前答案在很大程度上是“系统上的每个人，按其现有用量比例”。

segments.src: Every reform currently in motion is an attempt to change that answer before the next several auctions lock it in.
segments.tr: 目前正在进行的每项改革都是尝试在接下来的几次拍卖将其锁定之前改变这个答案。

segments.src: *Figures in this article are drawn from PJM's published Base Residual Auction results, its independent market monitor's public analyses, and filings at FERC and state utility commissions.
segments.tr: *本文中的数据来自 PJM 公布的基础剩余拍卖结果、其独立市场监督员的公开分析，以及向 FERC 和州公用事业委员会提交的文件。

segments.src: Auction results and reform proceedings are updated regularly; for the current numbers, consult PJM's posted auction reports and your state commission's docket.
segments.tr: 拍卖结果和改革程序会定期更新；如需当前数字，请参考 PJM 发布的拍卖报告和州委员会的案卷。

segments.src: Bill impact ranges are estimates and will differ by utility, zone, and service class.
segments.tr: 账单影响范围是估计值，将根据公用事业公司、区域和服务类别而有所不同。

segments.src: This is general information, not investment or legal advice.*
segments.tr: 这是通用信息，而非投资或法律建议。*

hi.title: आपका बिजली बिल अब आंशिक रूप से एक AI बिल है: उस नीलामी की अंदरूनी कहानी जिसने अमेरिका के डेटा सेंटर बूम की कीमत तय की

segments.src: Most people will never read a capacity auction report.
segments.tr: अधिकांश लोग क्षमता नीलामी (capacity auction) रिपोर्ट कभी नहीं पढ़ेंगे।

segments.src: But if you live in one of the 13 states or the District of Columbia served by the PJM Interconnection — roughly 65 million people, from Chicago to Newark to Richmond — one line in that report has more influence over your next electricity bill than almost anything happening in your own house.
segments.tr: लेकिन यदि आप उन 13 राज्यों या कोलंबिया जिले में रहते हैं जिन्हें PJM इंटरकनेक्शन द्वारा सेवा प्रदान की जाती है — शिकागो से न्यूआर्क और रिचमंड तक लगभग 6.5 करोड़ लोग — तो उस रिपोर्ट की एक पंक्ति आपके अगले बिजली बिल पर आपके अपने घर में होने वाली लगभग किसी भी चीज़ से अधिक प्रभाव डालती है।

segments.src: That line is the clearing price.
segments.tr: वह पंक्ति 'क्लियरिंग प्राइस' (clearing price) है।

segments.src: For the delivery year that runs June 1, 2026 through May 31, 2027, it came in at **$329.17 per megawatt-day** — the effective ceiling allowed in the auction.
segments.tr: 1 जून, 2026 से 31 मई, 2027 तक चलने वाले डिलीवरी वर्ष के लिए, यह **$329.17 प्रति मेगावाट-दिन** रहा — जो नीलामी में अनुमति दी गई प्रभावी सीमा (ceiling) थी।

segments.src: Two delivery years earlier, the comparable price was **$28.92**.
segments.tr: दो डिलीवरी वर्ष पहले, इसी तरह की कीमत **$28.92** थी।

segments.src: That is not a typo, and it is not inflation.
segments.tr: यह कोई टाइपिंग की गलती नहीं है, और न ही यह मुद्रास्फीति (inflation) है।

segments.src: It is the price of promising that the lights stay on in a grid where demand has started growing again after roughly two decades of sitting flat — and where the fastest-growing single category of new demand is the data center.
segments.tr: यह उस वादे की कीमत है कि ग्रिड में लाइटें जलती रहेंगी, जहाँ मांग लगभग दो दशकों तक स्थिर रहने के बाद फिर से बढ़ने लगी है — और जहाँ नई मांग की सबसे तेज़ी से बढ़ने वाली एकल श्रेणी डेटा सेंटर है।

segments.src: ## The three numbers that tell the story
segments.tr: ## कहानी बताने वाले तीन आंकड़े

segments.src: | Delivery year | RTO-wide clearing price | Approximate total capacity cost |
segments.tr: | डिलीवरी वर्ष | RTO-व्यापी क्लियरिंग प्राइस | अनुमानित कुल क्षमता लागत |

segments.src: | 2026 / 2027 | $329.17 per MW-day (at the cap) | ~$16.1 billion |
The 2026/27 auction, whose results PJM published in late July 2025, secured roughly 134,300 megawatts of capacity — a reserve margin somewhere near 19%, comfortably above the target.
segments.tr: 2026/27 की नीलामी, जिसके परिणाम PJM ने जुलाई 2025 के अंत में प्रकाशित किए थे, ने लगभग 134,300 मेगावाट क्षमता सुरक्षित की — एक रिज़र्व मार्जिन जो लगभग 19% था, जो लक्ष्य से काफी ऊपर था।

segments.src: In other words, the system did not come up short.
segments.tr: दूसरे शब्दों में, सिस्टम में कोई कमी नहीं आई।

segments.src: It simply became far more expensive to keep it that way.
segments.tr: बस इसे इस तरह बनाए रखना बहुत अधिक महंगा हो गया।

segments.src: ## What a capacity auction actually is
segments.tr: ## क्षमता नीलामी (capacity auction) वास्तव में क्या है

segments.src: This is the part that gets skipped, and it is the part that matters.
segments.tr: यह वह हिस्सा है जिसे छोड़ दिया जाता है, और यही वह हिस्सा है जो मायने रखता है।

segments.src: Electricity markets pay for two different things.
segments.tr: बिजली बाजार दो अलग-अलग चीजों के लिए भुगतान करते हैं।

segments.src: One is **energy** — the actual kilowatt-hours you use, priced more or less continuously.
segments.tr: एक है **ऊर्जा (energy)** — वास्तविक किलोवाट-घंटे जो आप उपयोग करते हैं, जिसकी कीमत कमोबेश निरंतर तय होती है।

segments.src: The other is **capacity** — a standing commitment from a power plant, a demand-response aggregator, or a battery to be available and deliver during the worst hours of the year: the January morning when everything is frozen, the July afternoon when everything is running.
segments.tr: दूसरा है **क्षमता (capacity)** — एक पावर प्लांट, डिमांड-रिस्पॉन्स एग्रीगेटर, या बैटरी की ओर से एक स्थायी प्रतिबद्धता कि वह वर्ष के सबसे खराब घंटों के दौरान उपलब्ध होगी और बिजली प्रदान करेगी: जैसे जनवरी की वह सुबह जब सब कुछ जम जाता है, या जुलाई की वह दोपहर जब सब कुछ चल रहा होता है।

segments.src: PJM buys that commitment years ahead through the Base Residual Auction.
segments.tr: PJM बेस रेजिडुअल ऑक्शन (Base Residual Auction) के माध्यम से वर्षों पहले उस प्रतिबद्धता को खरीदता है।

segments.src: Suppliers offer to be available; PJM buys until it has enough to meet a reliability requirement; and — this is the crucial mechanic — **every cleared supplier gets paid the same clearing price**, set by the most expensive offer needed to fill the requirement.
segments.tr: आपूर्तिकर्ता उपलब्ध होने की पेशकश करते हैं; PJM तब तक खरीदता है जब तक कि उसके पास विश्वसनीयता आवश्यकता को पूरा करने के लिए पर्याप्त क्षमता न हो; और — यह सबसे महत्वपूर्ण तंत्र है — **प्रत्येक क्लियर किए गए आपूर्तिकर्ता को एक ही क्लियरिंग प्राइस का भुगतान किया जाता है**, जो आवश्यकता को पूरा करने के लिए आवश्यक सबसे महंगे प्रस्ताव द्वारा निर्धारित किया जाता है।

segments.src: Not their own asking price.
segments.tr: उनकी अपनी मांगी गई कीमत नहीं।

segments.src: The market price.
segments.tr: बाजार की कीमत।

segments.src: That single design choice is why the number moves so violently.
segments.tr: डिजाइन का वह एक चुनाव ही कारण है कि यह संख्या इतनी हिंसक रूप से बदलती है।

segments.src: When the requirement rises past the cheap, already-built supply and starts reaching into the expensive tail of the offer stack, the price for *everything* resets upward at once.
segments.tr: जब आवश्यकता सस्ते, पहले से निर्मित आपूर्ति से आगे बढ़कर प्रस्तावों की सूची के महंगे छोर तक पहुँचने लगती है, तो *हर चीज़* की कीमत एक साथ ऊपर की ओर रीसेट हो जाती है।

segments.src: A modest increase in demand can produce a very immodest increase in cost.
segments.tr: मांग में मामूली वृद्धि लागत में बहुत बड़ी वृद्धि पैदा कर सकती है।

segments.src: Then the cost gets spread.
segments.tr: फिर लागत को फैलाया जाता है।

segments.src: Utilities buy capacity on behalf of their customers and pass the charge through — showing up in the supply or generation portion of your bill, in your state's price-to-compare, or in a competitive supplier's rate.
segments.tr: यूटिलिटीज अपने ग्राहकों की ओर से क्षमता खरीदती हैं और शुल्क को आगे बढ़ा देती हैं — जो आपके बिल के आपूर्ति या उत्पादन वाले हिस्से में, आपके राज्य के 'प्राइस-टू-कंपेयर' में, या किसी प्रतिस्पर्धी आपूर्तिकर्ता की दर में दिखाई देता है।

segments.src: You never see a line item called "capacity auction."
segments.tr: आपको कभी "क्षमता नीलामी" (capacity auction) नाम की कोई लाइन आइटम नहीं दिखती।

segments.src: You just see a bigger number.
segments.tr: आपको बस एक बड़ी संख्या दिखाई देती है।

segments.src: ## Why the price hit the ceiling
segments.tr: ## कीमत सीमा (ceiling) तक क्यों पहुँची

segments.src: Three pressures arrived at the same time.
segments.tr: तीन दबाव एक ही समय में आए।

segments.src: **Supply left.** Coal and older oil- and gas-fired units have been retiring on economics, age, and environmental compliance schedules.
segments.tr: **आपूर्ति कम हुई।** कोयला और पुराने तेल एवं गैस से चलने वाली इकाइयाँ आर्थिक कारणों, उम्र और पर्यावरणीय अनुपालन समय सारिणी के कारण सेवानिवृत्त हो रही हैं।

segments.src: Once a plant deactivates, its capacity stops showing up in the auction.
segments.tr: एक बार जब कोई प्लांट निष्क्रिय हो जाता है, तो उसकी क्षमता नीलामी में दिखना बंद हो जाती है।

segments.src: **Replacement is slow.** New solar, wind, storage, and gas projects have to clear interconnection studies, permitting, local approval, financing, and equipment orders.
segments.tr: **प्रतिस्थापन धीमा है।** नए सौर, पवन, स्टोरेज और गैस प्रोजेक्ट्स को इंटरकनेक्शन स्टडीज, परमिट, स्थानीय मंजूरी, फाइनेंसिंग और उपकरण ऑर्डर से गुजरना पड़ता है।

segments.src: PJM's queue holds a very large volume of proposed projects; the constraint is not developer interest but the pace of study, construction, and delivery.
segments.tr: PJM की कतार में प्रस्तावित परियोजनाओं की एक बहुत बड़ी मात्रा है; बाधा डेवलपर की रुचि नहीं बल्कि अध्ययन, निर्माण और डिलीवरी की गति है।

segments.src: Heavy-duty gas turbines in particular are effectively sold out well into the next decade, with order backlogs at the handful of firms that build them.
segments.tr: विशेष रूप से भारी-भरकम गैस टर्बाइन अगले दशक तक प्रभावी रूप से बिक चुके हैं, और उन्हें बनाने वाली मुट्ठी भर कंपनियों के पास ऑर्डर का भारी बैकलॉग है।

segments.src: **Demand turned upward.** After years of flat load, PJM's forecasts now show substantial peak growth through 2030 — the sharpest revision the region has seen in a generation.
segments.tr: **मांग ऊपर की ओर मुड़ी।** वर्षों तक स्थिर लोड के बाद, PJM के पूर्वानुमान अब 2030 तक पर्याप्त पीक ग्रोथ दिखाते हैं — यह इस क्षेत्र में एक पीढ़ी में देखा गया सबसे तीव्र संशोधन है।

segments.src: Electrification contributes.
segments.tr: इलेक्ट्रिफिकेशन (विद्युतीकरण) योगदान देता है।

segments.src: Manufacturing contributes.
segments.tr: विनिर्माण (मैन्युफैक्चरिंग) योगदान देता है।

segments.src: But the category driving the revision is large data-center load, concentrated heavily in Northern Virginia and spreading into Ohio, Pennsylvania, Indiana, and Maryland.
segments.tr: लेकिन जिस श्रेणी ने इस संशोधन को प्रेरित किया है, वह बड़े डेटा-सेंटर लोड हैं, जो उत्तरी वर्जीनिया में भारी रूप से केंद्रित हैं और ओहियो, पेंसिल्वेनिया, इंडियाना और मैरीलैंड में फैल रहे हैं।

segments.src: Retirements plus slow replacement plus rising demand equals a tighter requirement met by a more expensive offer stack.
segments.tr: सेवानिवृत्ति प्लस धीमा प्रतिस्थापन प्लस बढ़ती मांग का मतलब है एक सख्त आवश्यकता जिसे अधिक महंगे प्रस्तावों के ढेर से पूरा किया जाता है।

segments.src: The auction did what it was designed to do: it printed a very loud price signal.
segments.tr: नीलामी ने वही किया जिसके लिए इसे डिजाइन किया गया था: इसने एक बहुत ही स्पष्ट मूल्य संकेत (price signal) दिया।

segments.src: ## How much of this is really AI?
segments.tr: ## इसमें वास्तव में AI का कितना हिस्सा है?

segments.src: Here the honest answer requires care, because this is where public discussion tends to get sloppy.
segments.tr: यहाँ ईमानदार उत्तर के लिए सावधानी की आवश्यकता है, क्योंकि यहीं पर सार्वजनिक चर्चा अक्सर अस्पष्ट हो जाती है।

segments.src: PJM's independent market monitor, which analyzes the auction separately from PJM itself, has published assessments attributing the large majority of the recent price increases to growth in large load — data centers above all.
segments.tr: PJM का स्वतंत्र बाजार निगरानीकर्ता (independent market monitor), जो PJM से अलग नीलामी का विश्लेषण करता है, ने ऐसे आकलन प्रकाशित किए हैं जिनमें हाल की मूल्य वृद्धियों के बड़े बहुमत का श्रेय बड़े लोड की वृद्धि — मुख्य रूप से डेटा सेंटरों — को दिया गया है।

segments.src: Under that analysis, if data-center demand growth were removed from the reliability requirement, the clearing price would be dramatically lower.
segments.tr: उस विश्लेषण के अनुसार, यदि विश्वसनीयता आवश्यकता से डेटा-सेंटर मांग वृद्धि को हटा दिया जाए, तो क्लियरिंग प्राइस नाटकीय रूप से कम होगा।

segments.src: That is a modeled counterfactual, not a measurement, and reasonable analysts dispute the exact share.
segments.tr: यह एक मॉडल किया गया काउंटरफैक्टुअल है, माप नहीं, और उचित विश्लेषक सटीक हिस्से पर विवाद करते हैं।

segments.src: But the direction is not seriously contested: data centers are the dominant swing factor.
segments.tr: लेकिन दिशा पर गंभीरता से कोई विवाद नहीं है: डेटा सेंटर प्रमुख निर्णायक कारक (swing factor) हैं।

segments.src: Two fair counterpoints belong alongside it.
segments.tr: इसके साथ दो उचित प्रति-तर्क भी होने चाहिए।

segments.src: First, data centers do pay.
segments.tr: पहला, डेटा सेंटर भुगतान करते हैं।

segments.src: They pay retail tariffs, they pay capacity charges proportional to their contribution to peak, and in many cases they pay for interconnection upgrades directly.
segments.tr: वे रिटेल टैरिफ देते हैं, वे पीक में अपने योगदान के अनुपात में क्षमता शुल्क देते हैं, और कई मामलों में वे इंटरकनेक्शन अपग्रेड के लिए सीधे भुगतान करते हैं।

segments.src: They are not receiving free electricity.
segments.tr: उन्हें मुफ्त बिजली नहीं मिल रही है।

segments.src: Second, the grievance is about **allocation and risk**, not theft.
segments.tr: दूसरा, शिकायत **आवंटन और जोखिम** के बारे में है, चोरी के बारे में नहीं।

segments.src: When a uniform clearing price resets because one customer class is adding gigawatts, every other customer — the household, the school district, the machine shop — pays the new price on their existing consumption too.
segments.tr: जब एक ग्राहक वर्ग के गीगावाट जोड़ने के कारण एक समान क्लियरिंग प्राइस रीसेट होता है, तो हर दूसरा ग्राहक — घर, स्कूल जिला, मशीन शॉप — अपने मौजूदा उपभोग पर भी नई कीमत का भुगतान करता है।

segments.src: The build-out's cost is socialized across the whole footprint, while the revenue from the build-out is not.
segments.tr: बिल्ड-आउट की लागत पूरे क्षेत्र में सामाजिक रूप से साझा की जाती है, जबकि बिल्ड-आउट से होने वाला राजस्व साझा नहीं होता।

segments.src: That asymmetry, rather than any single company's behavior, is the actual policy problem.
segments.tr: वह विषमता, न कि किसी एक कंपनी का व्यवहार, वास्तविक नीतिगत समस्या है।

segments.src: ## What this looks like on your bill
segments.tr: ## आपके बिल पर यह कैसा दिखता है

segments.src: PJM's own estimate for the 2026/27 result was an increase in the range of roughly **1.5% to 5% on typical residential bills**, varying by zone — layered on top of the considerably larger increase already working its way through from the prior auction.
segments.tr: 2026/27 परिणाम के लिए PJM का अपना अनुमान था कि विशिष्ट आवासीय बिलों पर लगभग **1.5% से 5% की वृद्धि** होगी, जो ज़ोन के अनुसार अलग-अलग होगी — यह पिछली नीलामी से पहले से ही आ रही काफी बड़ी वृद्धि के ऊपर अतिरिक्त बोझ होगा।

segments.src: Several things make the lived experience messier than that range suggests:
segments.tr: कई चीजें वास्तविक अनुभव को उस सीमा से अधिक जटिल बनाती हैं:

segments.src: - **Timing varies.** States and utilities procure default supply on different cycles, so the same auction lands in different months and different chunks depending on where you live.
segments.tr: - **समय अलग-अलग होता है।** राज्य और यूटिलिटीज अलग-अलग चक्रों में डिफॉल्ट आपूर्ति प्राप्त करते हैं, इसलिए एक ही नीलामी आपके रहने के स्थान के आधार पर अलग-अलग महीनों और अलग-अलग हिस्सों में आती है।

segments.src: - **Zones differ.** Transmission constraints mean some areas clear above the RTO-wide price, and those customers absorb more.
segments.tr: - **ज़ोन अलग होते हैं।** ट्रांसमिशन बाधाओं का मतलब है कि कुछ क्षेत्र RTO-व्यापी कीमत से ऊपर क्लियर होते हैं, और वे ग्राहक अधिक बोझ उठाते हैं।

segments.src: - **Capacity is only part of the bill.** Transmission investment, distribution rates, and fuel costs move on their own schedules and can pull the total in the same direction at the same time.
segments.tr: - **क्षमता बिल का केवल एक हिस्सा है।** ट्रांसमिशन निवेश, वितरण दरें और ईंधन लागत अपने स्वयं के समय सारिणी पर चलते हैं और कुल लागत को एक ही समय में उसी दिशा में खींच सकते हैं।

segments.src: If you want your actual number rather than an average, the practical path is your utility's rate filing or price-to-compare notice at your state public utility commission — that document shows the supply cost being passed through, in your zone, for your service class.
segments.tr: यदि आप औसत के बजाय अपनी वास्तविक संख्या चाहते हैं, तो व्यावहारिक रास्ता आपकी यूटिलिटी की रेट फाइलिंग या आपके राज्य के सार्वजनिक यूटिलिटी कमीशन में 'प्राइस-टू-कंपेयर' नोटिस है — वह दस्तावेज़ आपके ज़ोन में, आपकी सेवा श्रेणी के लिए पास किए जा रहे आपूर्ति लागत को दिखाता है।

segments.src: ## Who is trying to fix it, and how
segments.tr: ## इसे कौन ठीक करने की कोशिश कर रहा है, और कैसे

segments.src: The response has been unusually fast by energy-regulation standards.
segments.tr: ऊर्जा-विनियमन मानकों के हिसाब से प्रतिक्रिया असामान्य रूप से तेज़ रही है।

segments.src: **A price collar.** After Pennsylvania's governor challenged the auction rules at the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, PJM and the state reached a settlement that FERC approved: a floor and a ceiling on the clearing price for the 2026/27 and 2027/28 auctions.
segments.tr: **एक प्राइस कॉलर (price collar)।** पेंसिल्वेनिया के गवर्नर ने फेडरल एनर्जी रेगुलेटरी कमीशन (FERC) में नीलामी नियमों को चुनौती दी, जिसके बाद PJM और राज्य के बीच एक समझौता हुआ जिसे FERC ने मंजूरी दी: 2026/27 और 2027/28 नीलामी के लिए क्लियरिंग प्राइस पर एक फ्लोर (न्यूनतम) और एक सीलिंग (अधिकतम) सीमा।

segments.src: The ceiling is precisely why 2026/27 stopped at $329.17.
segments.tr: सीलिंग ठीक वही कारण है कि 2026/27 की कीमत $329.17 पर रुक गई।

segments.src: Absent that cap, the price would very likely have gone higher — a detail worth remembering when reading the number.
segments.tr: उस कैप के बिना, कीमत बहुत संभवतः और ऊपर जाती — एक विवरण जिसे संख्या पढ़ते समय याद रखना उचित है।

segments.src: **Faster interconnection for what's needed.** PJM created a fast-track pathway to move a limited slate of projects that add reliable capacity quickly, alongside broader reforms to its interconnection process.
segments.tr: **आवश्यक चीजों के लिए तेज़ इंटरकनेक्शन।** PJM ने उन परियोजनाओं की एक सीमित सूची को तेज़ी से आगे बढ़ाने के लिए एक फास्ट-ट्रैक रास्ता बनाया जो विश्वसनीय क्षमता को जल्दी जोड़ती हैं, साथ ही अपनी इंटरकनेक्शन प्रक्रिया में व्यापक सुधार किए।

segments.src: **Making large loads carry their own weight.** This is the most consequential front.
segments.tr: **बड़े लोड को अपना बोझ खुद उठाने देना।** यह सबसे महत्वपूर्ण मोर्चा है।

segments.src: Regulators and utilities across the footprint are reworking how very large customers are treated: minimum-demand contracts so a data center pays for most of the capacity it reserves whether or not it uses it, separate rate classes for large loads, collateral and exit provisions, and rules for "bring your own generation" or co-located supply arrangements.
segments.tr: पूरे क्षेत्र के नियामक और यूटिलिटीज इस बात पर फिर से काम कर रहे हैं कि बहुत बड़े ग्राहकों के साथ कैसा व्यवहार किया जाए: न्यूनतम-मांग अनुबंध ताकि एक डेटा सेंटर उस क्षमता के अधिकांश हिस्से के लिए भुगतान करे जिसे वह आरक्षित करता है चाहे वह उसका उपयोग करे या न करे, बड़े लोड के लिए अलग दर श्रेणियां, कोलैटरल और एग्जिट प्रावधान, और "अपना स्वयं का उत्पादन लाएं" या सह-स्थित (co-located) आपूर्ति व्यवस्था के नियम।

segments.src: Ohio approved a large-load framework along these lines, and similar proceedings have opened elsewhere.
segments.tr: ओहियो ने इन लाइनों पर एक लार्ज-लोड फ्रेमवर्क को मंजूरी दी, और इसी तरह की कार्यवाही अन्य जगहों पर भी शुरू हुई है।

segments.src: FERC has taken up the co-location question for PJM specifically.
segments.tr: FERC ने विशेष रूप से PJM के लिए सह-स्थान (co-location) के प्रश्न को उठाया है।

segments.src: **Demand flexibility.** Because the requirement is driven by a handful of peak hours, a data center willing to curtail or shift to on-site generation during those hours reduces the requirement itself.
segments.tr: **मांग लचीलापन (Demand flexibility)।** क्योंकि आवश्यकता कुछ पीक घंटों द्वारा संचालित होती है, एक डेटा सेंटर जो उन घंटों के दौरान कटौती करने या ऑन-साइट उत्पादन पर स्विच करने के लिए तैयार है, वह स्वयं आवश्यकता को कम करता है।

segments.src: Several operators have signaled willingness; turning that into enforceable, verifiable commitments is the unfinished work.
segments.tr: कई ऑपरेटरों ने इच्छा जताई है; इसे लागू करने योग्य, सत्यापन योग्य प्रतिबद्धताओं में बदलना अभी अधूरा काम है।

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या देखना है

segments.src: - **Subsequent auction results.** Each new Base Residual Auction tests whether new supply and demand-side commitments are arriving fast enough to pull the price off the ceiling — and what happens when the collar's coverage ends.
segments.tr: - **बाद की नीलामी के परिणाम।** प्रत्येक नई बेस रेजिडुअल ऑक्शन यह परीक्षण करती है कि क्या नई आपूर्ति और मांग-पक्ष प्रतिबद्धताएं इतनी तेज़ी से आ रही हैं कि कीमत को सीलिंग से नीचे लाया जा सके — और क्या होता है जब कॉलर का कवरेज समाप्त हो जाता है।

segments.src: - **Whether large-load tariffs actually bind.** A rate class only shifts cost if its minimum-take and collateral terms survive negotiation and litigation intact.
segments.tr: - **क्या लार्ज-लोड टैरिफ वास्तव में बाध्यकारी हैं।** एक दर श्रेणी केवल तभी लागत को स्थानांतरित करती है जब उसकी न्यूनतम-टेक और कोलैटरल शर्तें बातचीत और मुकदमेबाजी के बाद भी बरकरार रहें।

segments.src: - **Real megawatts, not announcements.** Announced generation projects are cheap; steel in the ground and turbines delivered are what changes an auction outcome.
segments.tr: - **वास्तविक मेगावाट, न कि घोषणाएं।** घोषित उत्पादन परियोजनाएं सस्ती होती हैं; ज़मीन में स्टील और डिलीवर किए गए टर्बाइन ही नीलामी के परिणाम को बदलते हैं।

segments.src: - **Whether load forecasts hold.** Some share of the interconnection requests in the pipeline is speculative or duplicated across utilities. If forecast demand is revised down, the requirement — and the price — follows.
segments.tr: - **क्या लोड पूर्वानुमान सही रहते हैं।** पाइपलाइन में इंटरकनेक्शन अनुरोधों का कुछ हिस्सा सट्टा आधारित या यूटिलिटीज के बीच दोहराया गया है। यदि पूर्वानुमानित मांग को नीचे संशोधित किया जाता है, तो आवश्यकता — और कीमत — भी कम हो जाती है।

segments.src: - **Political durability.** Rate increases of this size tend to outlast the technical debate. Legislative intervention in individual states is a live possibility.
segments.tr: - **राजनीतिक स्थायित्व।** इस आकार की दर वृद्धि अक्सर तकनीकी बहस से अधिक समय तक चलती है। व्यक्तिगत राज्यों में विधायी हस्तक्षेप एक जीवित संभावना है।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: The AI build-out has a price, and part of it is being paid through an obscure auction that most ratepayers have never heard of.
segments.tr: AI बिल्ड-आउट की एक कीमत है, और उसका एक हिस्सा एक अस्पष्ट नीलामी के माध्यम से भुगतान किया जा रहा है जिसे अधिकांश दर-दाताओं ने कभी नहीं सुना होगा।

segments.src: There is nothing hidden or improper about the mechanism — the rules are public, the results are published, and the market is doing exactly what a uniform-clearing-price market does when demand outruns cheap supply.
segments.tr: इस तंत्र में कुछ भी छिपा हुआ या अनुचित नहीं है — नियम सार्वजनिक हैं, परिणाम प्रकाशित होते हैं, और बाजार बिल्कुल वही कर रहा है जो एक यूनिफॉर्म-क्लियरिंग-प्राइस मार्केट तब करता है जब मांग सस्ती आपूर्ति से आगे निकल जाती है।

segments.src: What is genuinely unresolved is who should bear the cost.
segments.tr: जो वास्तव में अनसुलझा है, वह यह है कि लागत कौन वहन करे।

segments.src: Right now the answer is largely "everyone on the system, in proportion to their existing usage."
segments.tr: अभी इसका उत्तर काफी हद तक "सिस्टम पर हर कोई, उनके मौजूदा उपयोग के अनुपात में" है।

segments.src: Every reform currently in motion is an attempt to change that answer before the next several auctions lock it in.
segments.tr: वर्तमान में गतिमान हर सुधार इस उत्तर को बदलने का एक प्रयास है, इससे पहले कि अगली कई नीलामी इसे स्थायी बना दें।

segments.src: *Figures in this article are drawn from PJM's published Base Residual Auction results, its independent market monitor's public analyses, and filings at FERC and state utility commissions.
segments.tr: *इस लेख के आंकड़े PJM के प्रकाशित बेस रेजिडुअल ऑक्शन परिणामों, इसके स्वतंत्र बाजार निगरानीकर्ता के सार्वजनिक विश्लेषणों, और FERC और राज्य यूटिलिटी कमीशनों की फाइलिंग से लिए गए हैं।

segments.src: Auction results and reform proceedings are updated regularly; for the current numbers, consult PJM's posted auction reports and your state commission's docket.
segments.tr: नीलामी के परिणाम और सुधार कार्यवाहियां नियमित रूप से अपडेट की जाती हैं; वर्तमान आंकड़ों के लिए, PJM की पोस्ट की गई नीलामी रिपोर्टों और आपके राज्य कमीशन के डॉकेट का परामर्श लें।

segments.src: Bill impact ranges are estimates and will differ by utility, zone, and service class.
segments.tr: बिल प्रभाव सीमाएं अनुमान हैं और यूटिलिटी, ज़ोन और सेवा श्रेणी के अनुसार भिन्न होंगी।

segments.src: This is general information, not investment or legal advice.*
segments.tr: यह सामान्य जानकारी है, निवेश या कानूनी सलाह नहीं।*

es.title: Su factura de luz ahora es en parte una factura de IA: Por dentro de la subasta que pone precio al auge de los centros de datos en Estados Unidos

segments.src: Most people will never read a capacity auction report.
segments.tr: La mayoría de las personas nunca leerán un informe de subasta de capacidad.

segments.src: But if you live in one of the 13 states or the District of Columbia served by the PJM Interconnection — roughly 65 million people, from Chicago to Newark to Richmond — one line in that report has more influence over your next electricity bill than almost anything happening in your own house.
segments.tr: Pero si vive en uno de los 13 estados o en el Distrito de Columbia atendidos por PJM Interconnection —aproximadamente 65 millones de personas, desde Chicago hasta Newark y Richmond— una línea de ese informe tiene más influencia sobre su próxima factura de electricidad que casi cualquier cosa que suceda en su propia casa.

segments.src: That line is the clearing price.
segments.tr: Esa línea es el precio de liquidación (clearing price).

segments.src: For the delivery year that runs June 1, 2026 through May 31, 2027, it came in at **$329.17 per megawatt-day** — the effective ceiling allowed in the auction.
segments.tr: Para el año de entrega que transcurre del 1 de junio de 2026 al 31 de mayo de 2027, se situó en **$329.17 por megavatio-día**, el techo efectivo permitido en la subasta.

segments.src: Two delivery years earlier, the comparable price was **$28.92**.
segments.tr: Dos años de entrega antes, el precio comparable era de **$28.92**.

segments.src: That is not a typo, and it is not inflation.
segments.tr: No es una errata, ni es inflación.

segments.src: It is the price of promising that the lights stay on in a grid where demand has started growing again after roughly two decades of sitting flat — and where the fastest-growing single category of new demand is the data center.
segments.tr: Es el precio de prometer que las luces permanezcan encendidas en una red donde la demanda ha comenzado a crecer nuevamente después de aproximadamente dos décadas de estancamiento, y donde la categoría de nueva demanda que crece más rápido es el centro de datos.

segments.src: ## The three numbers that tell the story
segments.tr: ## Los tres números que cuentan la historia

segments.src: | Delivery year | RTO-wide clearing price | Approximate total capacity cost |
segments.tr: | Año de entrega | Precio de liquidación en todo el RTO | Costo total aproximado de capacidad |
| 2024 / 2025 | $28.92 por MW-día | ~$2.2 mil millones |
| 2025 / 2026 | $269.92 por MW-día | ~$14.7 mil millones |

segments.src: | 2026 / 2027 | $329.17 per MW-day (at the cap) | ~$16.1 billion |
segments.tr: | 2026 / 2027 | $329.17 por MW-día (en el tope) | ~$16.1 mil millones |

segments.src: The 2026/27 auction, whose results PJM published in late July 2025, secured roughly 134,300 megawatts of capacity — a reserve margin somewhere near 19%, comfortably above the target.
segments.tr: La subasta de 2026/27, cuyos resultados publicó PJM a finales de julio de 2025, aseguró aproximadamente 134,300 megavatios de capacidad, un margen de reserva cercano al 19%, cómodamente por encima del objetivo.

segments.src: In other words, the system did not come up short.
segments.tr: En otras palabras, el sistema no se quedó corto.

segments.src: It simply became far more expensive to keep it that way.
segments.tr: Simplemente se volvió mucho más caro mantenerlo así.

segments.src: ## What a capacity auction actually is
segments.tr: ## Qué es en realidad una subasta de capacidad

segments.src: This is the part that gets skipped, and it is the part that matters.
segments.tr: Esta es la parte que se suele omitir, y es la parte que importa.

segments.src: Electricity markets pay for two different things.
segments.tr: Los mercados eléctricos pagan por dos cosas diferentes.

segments.src: One is **energy** — the actual kilowatt-hours you use, priced more or less continuously.
segments.tr: Una es la **energía**: los kilovatios-hora reales que utiliza, con un precio más o menos continuo.

segments.src: The other is **capacity** — a standing commitment from a power plant, a demand-response aggregator, or a battery to be available and deliver during the worst hours of the year: the January morning when everything is frozen, the July afternoon when everything is running.
segments.tr: La otra es la **capacidad**: un compromiso permanente de una planta de energía, un agregador de respuesta a la demanda o una batería para estar disponible y suministrar durante las horas más críticas del año: la mañana de enero cuando todo está congelado, la tarde de julio cuando todo está funcionando.

segments.src: PJM buys that commitment years ahead through the Base Residual Auction.
segments.tr: PJM compra ese compromiso con años de antelación a través de la Subasta Base Residual (Base Residual Auction).

segments.src: Suppliers offer to be available; PJM buys until it has enough to meet a reliability requirement; and — this is the crucial mechanic — **every cleared supplier gets paid the same clearing price**, set by the most expensive offer needed to fill the requirement.
segments.tr: Los proveedores se ofrecen a estar disponibles; PJM compra hasta que tiene suficiente para cumplir con un requisito de confiabilidad; y —este es el mecanismo crucial— **cada proveedor liquidado recibe el mismo precio de liquidación**, establecido por la oferta más cara necesaria para cubrir el requisito.

segments.src: Not their own asking price.
segments.tr: No su propio precio solicitado.

segments.src: The market price.
segments.tr: El precio de mercado.

segments.src: That single design choice is why the number moves so violently.
segments.tr: Esa única elección de diseño es la razón por la cual el número se mueve tan violentamente.

segments.src: When the requirement rises past the cheap, already-built supply and starts reaching into the expensive tail of the offer stack, the price for *everything* resets upward at once.
segments.tr: Cuando el requisito supera la oferta barata ya construida y comienza a alcanzar la cola costosa de la pila de ofertas, el precio de *todo* se restablece al alza de una vez.

segments.src: A modest increase in demand can produce a very immodest increase in cost.
segments.tr: Un aumento modesto en la demanda puede producir un aumento muy poco modesto en el costo.

segments.src: Then the cost gets spread.
segments.tr: Luego, el costo se distribuye.

segments.src: Utilities buy capacity on behalf of their customers and pass the charge through — showing up in the supply or generation portion of your bill, in your state's price-to-compare, or in a competitive supplier's rate.
segments.tr: Las empresas de servicios públicos compran capacidad en nombre de sus clientes y trasladan el cargo, que aparece en la parte de suministro o generación de su factura, en el precio de comparación de su estado o en la tarifa de un proveedor competitivo.

segments.src: You never see a line item called "capacity auction."
segments.tr: Usted nunca verá una línea llamada "subasta de capacidad".

segments.src: You just see a bigger number.
segments.tr: Solo verá un número más grande.

segments.src: ## Why the price hit the ceiling
segments.tr: ## Por qué el precio alcanzó el techo

segments.src: Three pressures arrived at the same time.
segments.tr: Tres presiones llegaron al mismo tiempo.

segments.src: **Supply left.** Coal and older oil- and gas-fired units have been retiring on economics, age, and environmental compliance schedules.
segments.tr: **La oferta disminuyó.** Las unidades de carbón y las más antiguas de petróleo y gas se han estado retirando por razones económicas, edad y calendarios de cumplimiento ambiental.

segments.src: Once a plant deactivates, its capacity stops showing up in the auction.
segments.tr: Una vez que una planta se desactiva, su capacidad deja de aparecer en la subasta.

segments.src: **Replacement is slow.** New solar, wind, storage, and gas projects have to clear interconnection studies, permitting, local approval, financing, and equipment orders.
segments.tr: **El reemplazo es lento.** Los nuevos proyectos solares, eólicos, de almacenamiento y de gas deben superar estudios de interconexión, permisos, aprobaciones locales, financiamiento y pedidos de equipos.

segments.src: PJM's queue holds a very large volume of proposed projects; the constraint is not developer interest but the pace of study, construction, and delivery.
segments.tr: La cola de PJM contiene un volumen muy grande de proyectos propuestos; la restricción no es el interés del desarrollador, sino el ritmo de estudio, construcción y entrega.

segments.src: Heavy-duty gas turbines in particular are effectively sold out well into the next decade, with order backlogs at the handful of firms that build them.
segments.tr: Las turbinas de gas de alta potencia, en particular, están prácticamente agotadas hasta bien entrada la próxima década, con listas de espera de pedidos en el puñado de empresas que las fabrican.

segments.src: **Demand turned upward.** After years of flat load, PJM's forecasts now show substantial peak growth through 2030 — the sharpest revision the region has seen in a generation.
segments.tr: **La demanda aumentó.** Después de años de carga plana, los pronósticos de PJM ahora muestran un crecimiento sustancial de los picos hasta 2030, la revisión más drástica que la región ha visto en una generación.

segments.src: Electrification contributes.
segments.tr: La electrificación contribuye.

segments.src: Manufacturing contributes.
segments.tr: La manufactura contribuye.

segments.src: But the category driving the revision is large data-center load, concentrated heavily in Northern Virginia and spreading into Ohio, Pennsylvania, Indiana, and Maryland.
segments.tr: Pero la categoría que impulsa la revisión es la gran carga de los centros de datos, concentrada fuertemente en el norte de Virginia y extendiéndose hacia Ohio, Pensilvania, Indiana y Maryland.

segments.src: Retirements plus slow replacement plus rising demand equals a tighter requirement met by a more expensive offer stack.
segments.tr: Retiros más reemplazo lento más demanda creciente es igual a un requisito más ajustado cubierto por una pila de ofertas más cara.

segments.src: The auction did what it was designed to do: it printed a very loud price signal.
segments.tr: La subasta hizo lo que fue diseñada para hacer: emitió una señal de precio muy fuerte.

segments.src: ## How much of this is really AI?
segments.tr: ## ¿Cuánto de esto es realmente IA?

segments.src: Here the honest answer requires care, because this is where public discussion tends to get sloppy.
segments.tr: Aquí la respuesta honesta requiere cuidado, porque es donde la discusión pública tiende a volverse imprecisa.

segments.src: PJM's independent market monitor, which analyzes the auction separately from PJM itself, has published assessments attributing the large majority of the recent price increases to growth in large load — data centers above all.
segments.tr: El monitor de mercado independiente de PJM, que analiza la subasta por separado de la propia PJM, ha publicado evaluaciones que atribuyen la gran mayoría de los aumentos de precios recientes al crecimiento de la gran carga, principalmente los centros de datos.

segments.src: Under that analysis, if data-center demand growth were removed from the reliability requirement, the clearing price would be dramatically lower.
segments.tr: Según ese análisis, si el crecimiento de la demanda de los centros de datos se eliminara del requisito de confiabilidad, el precio de liquidación sería drásticamente más bajo.

segments.src: That is a modeled counterfactual, not a measurement, and reasonable analysts dispute the exact share.
segments.tr: Eso es un contrafactual modelado, no una medición, y analistas razonables disputan la proporción exacta.

segments.src: But the direction is not seriously contested: data centers are the dominant swing factor.
segments.tr: Pero la dirección no está seriamente cuestionada: los centros de datos son el factor determinante dominante.

segments.src: Two fair counterpoints belong alongside it.
segments.tr: Dos contrapuntos justos deben acompañar esto.

segments.src: First, data centers do pay.
segments.tr: Primero, los centros de datos sí pagan.

segments.src: They pay retail tariffs, they pay capacity charges proportional to their contribution to peak, and in many cases they pay for interconnection upgrades directly.
segments.tr: Pagan tarifas minoristas, pagan cargos de capacidad proporcionales a su contribución al pico y, en muchos casos, pagan directamente por las mejoras de interconexión.

segments.src: They are not receiving free electricity.
segments.tr: No están recibiendo electricidad gratuita.

segments.src: Second, the grievance is about **allocation and risk**, not theft.
segments.tr: Segundo, la queja es sobre la **asignación y el riesgo**, no sobre el robo.

segments.src: When a uniform clearing price resets because one customer class is adding gigawatts, every other customer — the household, the school district, the machine shop — pays the new price on their existing consumption too.
segments.tr: Cuando un precio de liquidación uniforme se restablece porque una clase de cliente está agregando gigavatios, todos los demás clientes —el hogar, el distrito escolar, el taller mecánico— también pagan el nuevo precio sobre su consumo existente.

segments.src: The build-out's cost is socialized across the whole footprint, while the revenue from the build-out is not.
segments.tr: El costo de la expansión se socializa en toda la huella, mientras que los ingresos de la expansión no lo son.

segments.src: That asymmetry, rather than any single company's behavior, is the actual policy problem.
segments.tr: Esa asimetría, más que el comportamiento de cualquier empresa individual, es el problema político real.

segments.src: ## What this looks like on your bill
segments.tr: ## Cómo se ve esto en su factura

segments.src: PJM's own estimate for the 2026/27 result was an increase in the range of roughly **1.5% to 5% on typical residential bills**, varying by zone — layered on top of the considerably larger increase already working its way through from the prior auction.
segments.tr: La propia estimación de PJM para el resultado de 2026/27 fue un aumento en el rango de aproximadamente **1.5% a 5% en las facturas residenciales típicas**, variando según la zona, sumado al aumento considerablemente mayor que ya se está aplicando de la subasta anterior.

segments.src: Several things make the lived experience messier than that range suggests:
segments.tr: Varias cosas hacen que la experiencia vivida sea más compleja de lo que sugiere ese rango:

segments.src: - **Timing varies.** States and utilities procure default supply on different cycles, so the same auction lands in different months and different chunks depending on where you live.
segments.tr: - **El tiempo varía.** Los estados y las empresas de servicios públicos adquieren el suministro predeterminado en diferentes ciclos, por lo que la misma subasta llega en diferentes meses y en diferentes fragmentos dependiendo de dónde viva.

segments.src: - **Zones differ.** Transmission constraints mean some areas clear above the RTO-wide price, and those customers absorb more.
segments.tr: - **Las zonas difieren.** Las restricciones de transmisión significan que algunas áreas liquidan por encima del precio general del RTO, y esos clientes absorben más.

segments.src: - **Capacity is only part of the bill.** Transmission investment, distribution rates, and fuel costs move on their own schedules and can pull the total in the same direction at the same time.
segments.tr: - **La capacidad es solo parte de la factura.** La inversión en transmisión, las tarifas de distribución y los costos de combustible se mueven en sus propios calendarios y pueden empujar el total en la misma dirección al mismo tiempo.

segments.src: If you want your actual number rather than an average, the practical path is your utility's rate filing or price-to-compare notice at your state public utility commission — that document shows the supply cost being passed through, in your zone, for your service class.
segments.tr: Si desea conocer su número real en lugar de un promedio, el camino práctico es la presentación de tarifas de su empresa de servicios públicos o el aviso de precio de comparación en la comisión de servicios públicos públicos de su estado; ese documento muestra el costo de suministro que se traslada, en su zona, para su clase de servicio.

segments.src: ## Who is trying to fix it, and how
segments.tr: ## Quién está intentando solucionarlo y cómo

segments.src: The response has been unusually fast by energy-regulation standards.
segments.tr: La respuesta ha sido inusualmente rápida para los estándares de regulación energética.

segments.src: **A price collar.** After Pennsylvania's governor challenged the auction rules at the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, PJM and the state reached a settlement that FERC approved: a floor and a ceiling on the clearing price for the 2026/27 and 2027/28 auctions.
segments.tr: **Un collar de precios.** Después de que el gobernador de Pensilvania impugnara las reglas de la subasta ante la Comisión Federal Reguladora de Energía (FERC), PJM y el estado llegaron a un acuerdo que la FERC aprobó: un piso y un techo para el precio de liquidación de las subastas de 2026/27 y 2027/28.

segments.src: The ceiling is precisely why 2026/27 stopped at $329.17.
segments.tr: El techo es precisamente la razón por la cual 2026/27 se detuvo en $329.17.

segments.src: Absent that cap, the price would very likely have gone higher — a detail worth remembering when reading the number.
segments.tr: Sin ese tope, es muy probable que el precio hubiera sido más alto, un detalle que vale la pena recordar al leer el número.

segments.src: **Faster interconnection for what's needed.** PJM created a fast-track pathway to move a limited slate of projects that add reliable capacity quickly, alongside broader reforms to its interconnection process.
segments.tr: **Interconexión más rápida para lo que se necesita.** PJM creó una vía rápida para mover una lista limitada de proyectos que agreguen capacidad confiable rápidamente, junto con reformas más amplias a su proceso de interconexión.

segments.src: **Making large loads carry their own weight.** This is the most consequential front.
segments.tr: **Hacer que las grandes cargas asuman su propio peso.** Este es el frente más trascendental.

segments.src: Regulators and utilities across the footprint are reworking how very large customers are treated: minimum-demand contracts so a data center pays for most of the capacity it reserves whether or not it uses it, separate rate classes for large loads, collateral and exit provisions, and rules for "bring your own generation" or co-located supply arrangements.
segments.tr: Los reguladores y las empresas de servicios públicos en toda la región están rediseñando cómo se trata a los clientes muy grandes: contratos de demanda mínima para que un centro de datos pague la mayor parte de la capacidad que reserva, lo use o no, clases de tarifas separadas para grandes cargas, disposiciones de colateral y salida, y reglas para "traer su propia generación" o acuerdos de suministro co-ubicados.

segments.src: Ohio approved a large-load framework along these lines, and similar proceedings have opened elsewhere.
segments.tr: Ohio aprobó un marco de carga pesada en estos términos, y procedimientos similares se han abierto en otros lugares.

segments.src: FERC has taken up the co-location question for PJM specifically.
segments.tr: La FERC ha abordado la cuestión de la co-ubicación específicamente para PJM.
