in.title: Tagihan Listrik Anda Kini Sebagian Menjadi Tagihan AI: Di Balik Lelang yang Menentukan Harga Ledakan Pusat Data Amerika

segments.src: Most people will never read a capacity auction report.
segments.tr: Kebanyakan orang tidak akan pernah membaca laporan lelang kapasitas.

segments.src: But if you live in one of the 13 states or the District of Columbia served by the PJM Interconnection — roughly 65 million people, from Chicago to Newark to Richmond — one line in that report has more influence over your next electricity bill than almost anything happening in your own house.
segments.tr: Namun jika Anda tinggal di salah satu dari 13 negara bagian atau Distrik Columbia yang dilayani oleh PJM Interconnection — sekitar 65 juta orang, dari Chicago hingga Newark hingga Richmond — satu baris dalam laporan itu memiliki pengaruh lebih besar terhadap tagihan listrik Anda berikutnya daripada hampir semua hal yang terjadi di rumah Anda sendiri.

segments.src: That line is the clearing price.
segments.tr: Baris itu adalah harga pembersihan (clearing price).

segments.src: For the delivery year that runs June 1, 2026 through May 31, 2027, it came in at **$329.17 per megawatt-day** — the effective ceiling allowed in the auction.
segments.tr: Untuk tahun pengiriman yang berjalan dari 1 Juni 2026 hingga 31 Mei 2027, harganya mencapai **$329,17 per megawatt-hari** — batas atas efektif yang diizinkan dalam lelang.

segments.src: Two delivery years earlier, the comparable price was **$28.92**.
segments.tr: Dua tahun pengiriman sebelumnya, harga yang sebanding adalah **$28,92**.

segments.src: That is not a typo, and it is not inflation.
segments.tr: Itu bukan salah ketik, dan itu bukan inflasi.

segments.src: It is the price of promising that the lights stay on in a grid where demand has started growing again after roughly two decades of sitting flat — and where the fastest-growing single category of new demand is the data center.
segments.tr: Itu adalah harga dari janji bahwa lampu tetap menyala di jaringan di mana permintaan mulai tumbuh lagi setelah sekitar dua dekade stagnan — dan di mana kategori permintaan baru yang tumbuh paling cepat adalah pusat data.

segments.src: ## The three numbers that tell the story
segments.tr: ## Tiga angka yang menceritakan kisahnya

segments.src: | Delivery year | RTO-wide clearing price | Approximate total capacity cost |
segments.tr: | Tahun pengiriman | Harga pembersihan seluruh RTO | Perkiraan total biaya kapasitas |

segments.src: | 2026 / 2027 | $329.17 per MW-day (at the cap) | ~$16.1 billion |
segments.tr: | 2026 / 2027 | $329,17 per MW-hari (pada batas atas) | ~$16,1 miliar |

segments.src: The 2026/27 auction, whose results PJM published in late July 2025, secured roughly 134,300 megawatts of capacity — a reserve margin somewhere near 19%, comfortably above the target.
segments.tr: Lelang 2026/27, yang hasilnya dipublikasikan PJM pada akhir Juli 2025, mengamankan sekitar 134.300 megawatt kapasitas — margin cadangan sekitar 19%, jauh di atas target.

segments.src: In other words, the system did not come up short.
segments.tr: Dengan kata lain, sistem tersebut tidak kekurangan.

segments.src: It simply became far more expensive to keep it that way.
segments.tr: Hanya saja menjadi jauh lebih mahal untuk menjaganya tetap seperti itu.

segments.src: ## What a capacity auction actually is
segments.tr: ## Apa itu lelang kapasitas sebenarnya

segments.src: This is the part that gets skipped, and it is the part that matters.
segments.tr: Ini adalah bagian yang sering dilewati, dan inilah bagian yang penting.

segments.src: Electricity markets pay for two different things.
segments.tr: Pasar listrik membayar untuk dua hal yang berbeda.

segments.src: One is **energy** — the actual kilowatt-hours you use, priced more or less continuously.
segments.tr: Satu adalah **energi** — kilowatt-jam aktual yang Anda gunakan, dengan harga yang kurang lebih kontinu.

segments.src: The other is **capacity** — a standing commitment from a power plant, a demand-response aggregator, or a battery to be available and deliver during the worst hours of the year: the January morning when everything is frozen, the July afternoon when everything is running.
segments.tr: Yang lainnya adalah **kapasitas** — komitmen tetap dari pembangkit listrik, agregator respons permintaan, atau baterai untuk tersedia dan memberikan daya selama jam-jam terburuk dalam setahun: pagi hari di bulan Januari ketika semuanya membeku, sore hari di bulan Juli ketika semuanya menyala.

segments.src: PJM buys that commitment years ahead through the Base Residual Auction.
segments.tr: PJM membeli komitmen itu bertahun-tahun sebelumnya melalui Base Residual Auction.

segments.src: Suppliers offer to be available; PJM buys until it has enough to meet a reliability requirement; and — this is the crucial mechanic — **every cleared supplier gets paid the same clearing price**, set by the most expensive offer needed to fill the requirement.
segments.tr: Pemasok menawarkan ketersediaan; PJM membeli hingga memiliki cukup untuk memenuhi persyaratan keandalan; dan — ini adalah mekanisme krusialnya — **setiap pemasok yang lolos dibayar dengan harga pembersihan yang sama**, yang ditetapkan oleh penawaran termahal yang dibutuhkan untuk memenuhi persyaratan.

segments.src: Not their own asking price.
segments.tr: Bukan harga permintaan mereka sendiri.

segments.src: The market price.
segments.tr: Harga pasar.

segments.src: That single design choice is why the number moves so violently.
segments.tr: Pilihan desain tunggal itulah mengapa angka tersebut bergerak begitu drastis.

segments.src: When the requirement rises past the cheap, already-built supply and starts reaching into the expensive tail of the offer stack, the price for *everything* resets upward at once.
segments.tr: Ketika persyaratan meningkat melampaui pasokan murah yang sudah dibangun dan mulai mencapai ekor mahal dari tumpukan penawaran, harga untuk *segalanya* diatur ulang ke atas sekaligus.

segments.src: A modest increase in demand can produce a very immodest increase in cost.
segments.tr: Peningkatan permintaan yang moderat dapat menghasilkan peningkatan biaya yang sangat besar.

segments.src: Then the cost gets spread.
segments.tr: Kemudian biaya tersebut disebarkan.

segments.src: Utilities buy capacity on behalf of their customers and pass the charge through — showing up in the supply or generation portion of your bill, in your state's price-to-compare, or in a competitive supplier's rate.
segments.tr: Perusahaan utilitas membeli kapasitas atas nama pelanggan mereka dan meneruskan biayanya — muncul di bagian pasokan atau pembangkitan pada tagihan Anda, dalam harga perbandingan negara bagian Anda, atau dalam tarif pemasok kompetitif.

segments.src: You never see a line item called "capacity auction."
segments.tr: Anda tidak pernah melihat item baris bernama "lelang kapasitas."

segments.src: You just see a bigger number.
segments.tr: Anda hanya melihat angka yang lebih besar.

segments.src: ## Why the price hit the ceiling
segments.tr: ## Mengapa harga mencapai batas atas

segments.src: Three pressures arrived at the same time.
segments.tr: Tiga tekanan datang pada saat yang sama.

segments.src: **Supply left.** Coal and older oil- and gas-fired units have been retiring on economics, age, and environmental compliance schedules.
segments.tr: **Pasokan berkurang.** Unit berbahan bakar batu bara serta minyak dan gas yang lebih tua telah dipensiunkan karena alasan ekonomi, usia, dan jadwal kepatuhan lingkungan.

segments.src: Once a plant deactivates, its capacity stops showing up in the auction.
segments.tr: Setelah pembangkit dinonaktifkan, kapasitasnya berhenti muncul dalam lelang.

segments.src: **Replacement is slow.** New solar, wind, storage, and gas projects have to clear interconnection studies, permitting, local approval, financing, and equipment orders.
segments.tr: **Penggantian berjalan lambat.** Proyek surya, angin, penyimpanan, dan gas baru harus melewati studi interkoneksi, perizinan, persetujuan lokal, pembiayaan, dan pesanan peralatan.

segments.src: PJM's queue holds a very large volume of proposed projects; the constraint is not developer interest but the pace of study, construction, and delivery.
segments.tr: Antrean PJM menampung volume proyek yang diusulkan dalam jumlah sangat besar; kendalanya bukan pada minat pengembang tetapi pada kecepatan studi, konstruksi, dan pengiriman.

segments.src: Heavy-duty gas turbines in particular are effectively sold out well into the next decade, with order backlogs at the handful of firms that build them.
segments.tr: Turbin gas tugas berat khususnya sudah hampir habis terjual hingga dekade berikutnya, dengan tumpukan pesanan di segelintir perusahaan yang membangunnya.

segments.src: **Demand turned upward.** After years of flat load, PJM's forecasts now show substantial peak growth through 2030 — the sharpest revision the region has seen in a generation.
segments.tr: **Permintaan meningkat.** Setelah bertahun-tahun beban datar, prakiraan PJM sekarang menunjukkan pertumbuhan puncak yang substansial hingga 2030 — revisi tertajam yang pernah dilihat wilayah tersebut dalam satu generasi.

segments.src: Electrification contributes.
segments.tr: Elektrifikasi berkontribusi.

segments.src: Manufacturing contributes.
segments.tr: Manufaktur berkontribusi.

segments.src: But the category driving the revision is large data-center load, concentrated heavily in Northern Virginia and spreading into Ohio, Pennsylvania, Indiana, and Maryland.
segments.tr: Namun kategori yang mendorong revisi tersebut adalah beban pusat data besar, yang terkonsentrasi berat di Virginia Utara dan menyebar ke Ohio, Pennsylvania, Indiana, dan Maryland.

segments.src: Retirements plus slow replacement plus rising demand equals a tighter requirement met by a more expensive offer stack.
segments.tr: Pensiun ditambah penggantian lambat ditambah permintaan yang meningkat sama dengan persyaratan yang lebih ketat yang dipenuhi oleh tumpukan penawaran yang lebih mahal.

segments.src: The auction did what it was designed to do: it printed a very loud price signal.
segments.tr: Lelang tersebut melakukan apa yang dirancang untuk dilakukan: memberikan sinyal harga yang sangat keras.

segments.src: ## How much of this is really AI?
segments.tr: ## Seberapa banyak dari ini yang benar-benar AI?

segments.src: Here the honest answer requires care, because this is where public discussion tends to get sloppy.
segments.tr: Di sini jawaban jujur memerlukan kehati-hatian, karena di sinilah diskusi publik cenderung menjadi tidak rapi.

segments.src: PJM's independent market monitor, which analyzes the auction separately from PJM itself, has published assessments attributing the large majority of the recent price increases to growth in large load — data centers above all.
segments.tr: Pemantau pasar independen PJM, yang menganalisis lelang secara terpisah dari PJM sendiri, telah mempublikasikan penilaian yang mengaitkan sebagian besar peningkatan harga baru-baru ini dengan pertumbuhan beban besar — terutama pusat data.

segments.src: Under that analysis, if data-center demand growth were removed from the reliability requirement, the clearing price would be dramatically lower.
segments.tr: Berdasarkan analisis tersebut, jika pertumbuhan permintaan pusat data dihapus dari persyaratan keandalan, harga pembersihan akan jauh lebih rendah.

segments.src: That is a modeled counterfactual, not a measurement, and reasonable analysts dispute the exact share.
segments.tr: Itu adalah kontrafaktual yang dimodelkan, bukan pengukuran, dan analis yang masuk akal memperdebatkan pangsa tepatnya.

segments.src: But the direction is not seriously contested: data centers are the dominant swing factor.
segments.tr: Namun arahnya tidak disanggah secara serius: pusat data adalah faktor pengubah yang dominan.

segments.src: Two fair counterpoints belong alongside it.
segments.tr: Dua poin tandingan yang adil layak disertakan.

segments.src: First, data centers do pay.
segments.tr: Pertama, pusat data memang membayar.

segments.src: They pay retail tariffs, they pay capacity charges proportional to their contribution to peak, and in many cases they pay for interconnection upgrades directly.
segments.tr: Mereka membayar tarif ritel, mereka membayar biaya kapasitas proporsional dengan kontribusi mereka terhadap beban puncak, dan dalam banyak kasus mereka membayar peningkatan interkoneksi secara langsung.

segments.src: They are not receiving free electricity.
segments.tr: Mereka tidak menerima listrik gratis.

segments.src: Second, the grievance is about **allocation and risk**, not theft.
segments.tr: Kedua, keluhannya adalah tentang **alokasi dan risiko**, bukan pencurian.

segments.src: When a uniform clearing price resets because one customer class is adding gigawatts, every other customer — the household, the school district, the machine shop — pays the new price on their existing consumption too.
segments.tr: Ketika harga pembersihan seragam diatur ulang karena satu kelas pelanggan menambahkan gigawatt, setiap pelanggan lain — rumah tangga, distrik sekolah, bengkel mesin — juga membayar harga baru pada konsumsi mereka yang sudah ada.

segments.src: The build-out's cost is socialized across the whole footprint, while the revenue from the build-out is not.
segments.tr: Biaya pembangunan disosialisasikan ke seluruh jejak wilayah, sementara pendapatan dari pembangunan tersebut tidak.

segments.src: That asymmetry, rather than any single company's behavior, is the actual policy problem.
segments.tr: Asimetri itulah, bukan perilaku perusahaan mana pun, yang menjadi masalah kebijakan yang sebenarnya.

segments.src: ## What this looks like on your bill
segments.tr: ## Seperti apa tampilannya di tagihan Anda

segments.src: PJM's own estimate for the 2026/27 result was an increase in the range of roughly **1.5% to 5% on typical residential bills**, varying by zone — layered on top of the considerably larger increase already working its way through from the prior auction.
segments.tr: Perkiraan PJM sendiri untuk hasil 2026/27 adalah peningkatan dalam kisaran sekitar **1,5% hingga 5% pada tagihan residensial tipikal**, bervariasi menurut zona — berlapis di atas peningkatan yang jauh lebih besar yang sudah berjalan dari lelang sebelumnya.

segments.src: Several things make the lived experience messier than that range suggests:
segments.tr: Beberapa hal membuat pengalaman nyata lebih rumit daripada yang disarankan kisaran tersebut:

segments.src: - **Timing varies.** States and utilities procure default supply on different cycles, so the same auction lands in different months and different chunks depending on where you live.
segments.tr: - **Waktu bervariasi.** Negara bagian dan utilitas memperoleh pasokan default pada siklus yang berbeda, sehingga lelang yang sama mendarat di bulan yang berbeda dan dalam potongan yang berbeda tergantung di mana Anda tinggal.

segments.src: - **Zones differ.** Transmission constraints mean some areas clear above the RTO-wide price, and those customers absorb more.
segments.tr: - **Zona berbeda.** Kendala transmisi berarti beberapa area memiliki harga pembersihan di atas harga seluruh RTO, dan pelanggan tersebut menyerap lebih banyak.

segments.src: - **Capacity is only part of the bill.** Transmission investment, distribution rates, and fuel costs move on their own schedules and can pull the total in the same direction at the same time.
segments.tr: - **Kapasitas hanya bagian dari tagihan.** Investasi transmisi, tarif distribusi, dan biaya bahan bakar bergerak menurut jadwal mereka sendiri dan dapat menarik total ke arah yang sama pada saat yang sama.

segments.src: If you want your actual number rather than an average, the practical path is your utility's rate filing or price-to-compare notice at your state public utility commission — that document shows the supply cost being passed through, in your zone, for your service class.
segments.tr: Jika Anda menginginkan angka aktual Anda daripada rata-rata, jalur praktisnya adalah pengajuan tarif utilitas Anda atau pemberitahuan harga perbandingan di komisi utilitas publik negara bagian Anda — dokumen itu menunjukkan biaya pasokan yang diteruskan, di zona Anda, untuk kelas layanan Anda.

segments.src: ## Who is trying to fix it, and how
segments.tr: ## Siapa yang mencoba memperbaikinya, dan bagaimana

segments.src: The response has been unusually fast by energy-regulation standards.
segments.tr: Responsnya sangat cepat menurut standar regulasi energi.

segments.src: **A price collar.** After Pennsylvania's governor challenged the auction rules at the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, PJM and the state reached a settlement that FERC approved: a floor and a ceiling on the clearing price for the 2026/27 and 2027/28 auctions.
segments.tr: **Kolar harga.** Setelah gubernur Pennsylvania menggugat aturan lelang di Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, PJM dan negara bagian mencapai kesepakatan yang disetujui FERC: batas bawah dan batas atas pada harga pembersihan untuk lelang 2026/27 dan 2027/28.

segments.src: The ceiling is precisely why 2026/27 stopped at $329.17.
segments.tr: Batas atas itulah tepatnya mengapa 2026/27 berhenti di $329,17.

segments.src: Absent that cap, the price would very likely have gone higher — a detail worth remembering when reading the number.
segments.tr: Tanpa batas itu, harga kemungkinan besar akan naik lebih tinggi — detail yang patut diingat saat membaca angka tersebut.

segments.src: **Faster interconnection for what's needed.** PJM created a fast-track pathway to move a limited slate of projects that add reliable capacity quickly, alongside broader reforms to its interconnection process.
segments.tr: **Interkoneksi lebih cepat untuk yang dibutuhkan.** PJM membuat jalur cepat untuk memindahkan daftar terbatas proyek yang menambah kapasitas andal dengan cepat, bersama dengan reformasi lebih luas pada proses interkoneksinya.

segments.src: **Making large loads carry their own weight.** This is the most consequential front.
segments.tr: **Membuat beban besar memikul beban mereka sendiri.** Ini adalah front yang paling berdampak.

segments.src: Regulators and utilities across the footprint are reworking how very large customers are treated: minimum-demand contracts so a data center pays for most of the capacity it reserves whether or not it uses it, separate rate classes for large loads, collateral and exit provisions, and rules for "bring your own generation" or co-located supply arrangements.
segments.tr: Regulator dan utilitas di seluruh wilayah sedang merombak bagaimana pelanggan sangat besar diperlakukan: kontrak permintaan minimum sehingga pusat data membayar sebagian besar kapasitas yang dipesannya terlepas dari apakah ia menggunakannya atau tidak, kelas tarif terpisah untuk beban besar, ketentuan jaminan dan keluar, serta aturan untuk "membawa pembangkitan sendiri" atau pengaturan pasokan yang ditempatkan bersama.

segments.src: Ohio approved a large-load framework along these lines, and similar proceedings have opened elsewhere.
segments.tr: Ohio menyetujui kerangka kerja beban besar dengan garis ini, dan proses serupa telah dibuka di tempat lain.

segments.src: FERC has taken up the co-location question for PJM specifically.
segments.tr: FERC telah mengangkat pertanyaan ko-lokasi khusus untuk PJM.

segments.src: **Demand flexibility.** Because the requirement is driven by a handful of peak hours, a data center willing to curtail or shift to on-site generation during those hours reduces the requirement itself.
segments.tr: **Fleksibilitas permintaan.** Karena persyaratan didorong oleh segelintir jam puncak, pusat data yang bersedia mengurangi atau beralih ke pembangkitan di lokasi selama jam-jam tersebut mengurangi persyaratan itu sendiri.

segments.src: Several operators have signaled willingness; turning that into enforceable, verifiable commitments is the unfinished work.
segments.tr: Beberapa operator telah memberikan sinyal kesediaan; mengubah itu menjadi komitmen yang dapat ditegakkan dan diverifikasi adalah pekerjaan yang belum selesai.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang harus diperhatikan selanjutnya

segments.src: - **Subsequent auction results.** Each new Base Residual Auction tests whether new supply and demand-side commitments are arriving fast enough to pull the price off the ceiling — and what happens when the collar's coverage ends.
segments.tr: - **Hasil lelang berikutnya.** Setiap Base Residual Auction baru menguji apakah pasokan baru dan komitmen sisi permintaan tiba cukup cepat untuk menarik harga turun dari batas atas — dan apa yang terjadi ketika cakupan kolar berakhir.

segments.src: - **Whether large-load tariffs actually bind.** A rate class only shifts cost if its minimum-take and collateral terms survive negotiation and litigation intact.
segments.tr: - **Apakah tarif beban besar benar-benar mengikat.** Kelas tarif hanya menggeser biaya jika ketentuan pengambilan minimum dan jaminannya bertahan utuh melalui negosiasi dan litigasi.

segments.src: - **Real megawatts, not announcements.** Announced generation projects are cheap; steel in the ground and turbines delivered are what changes an auction outcome.
segments.tr: - **Megawatt nyata, bukan pengumuman.** Proyek pembangkitan yang diumumkan itu murah; baja di tanah dan turbin yang dikirimkan adalah apa yang mengubah hasil lelang.

segments.src: - **Whether load forecasts hold.** Some share of the interconnection requests in the pipeline is speculative or duplicated across utilities. If forecast demand is revised down, the requirement — and the price — follows.
segments.tr: - **Apakah prakiraan beban bertahan.** Sebagian dari permintaan interkoneksi dalam pipa bersifat spekulatif atau diduplikasi di berbagai utilitas. Jika permintaan prakiraan direvisi turun, persyaratan — dan harga — mengikutinya.

segments.src: - **Political durability.** Rate increases of this size tend to outlast the technical debate. Legislative intervention in individual states is a live possibility.
segments.tr: - **Ketahanan politik.** Peningkatan tarif sebesar ini cenderung bertahan lebih lama daripada debat teknis. Intervensi legislatif di negara bagian individu adalah kemungkinan yang nyata.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Inti masalahnya

segments.src: The AI build-out has a price, and part of it is being paid through an obscure auction that most ratepayers have never heard of.
segments.tr: Pembangunan AI memiliki harga, dan sebagian darinya dibayar melalui lelang yang tidak jelas yang tidak pernah didengar oleh sebagian besar pembayar tarif.

segments.src: There is nothing hidden or improper about the mechanism — the rules are public, the results are published, and the market is doing exactly what a uniform-clearing-price market does when demand outruns cheap supply.
segments.tr: Tidak ada yang tersembunyi atau tidak pantas tentang mekanisme tersebut — aturannya publik, hasilnya dipublikasikan, dan pasar melakukan tepat apa yang dilakukan pasar harga pembersihan seragam ketika permintaan melampaui pasokan murah.

segments.src: What is genuinely unresolved is who should bear the cost.
segments.tr: Apa yang benar-benar belum terselesaikan adalah siapa yang harus menanggung biayanya.

segments.src: Right now the answer is largely "everyone on the system, in proportion to their existing usage."
segments.tr: Saat ini jawabannya sebagian besar adalah "semua orang di sistem, secara proporsional dengan penggunaan mereka yang ada."

segments.src: Every reform currently in motion is an attempt to change that answer before the next several auctions lock it in.
segments.tr: Setiap reformasi yang saat ini sedang berjalan adalah upaya untuk mengubah jawaban itu sebelum beberapa lelang berikutnya menguncinya.

segments.src: *Figures in this article are drawn from PJM's published Base Residual Auction results, its independent market monitor's public analyses, and filings at FERC and state utility commissions.
segments.tr: *Angka-angka dalam artikel ini diambil dari hasil Base Residual Auction PJM yang dipublikasikan, analisis publik pemantau pasar independennya, dan pengajuan di FERC dan komisi utilitas negara bagian.

segments.src: Auction results and reform proceedings are updated regularly; for the current numbers, consult PJM's posted auction reports and your state commission's docket.
segments.tr: Hasil lelang dan proses reformasi diperbarui secara teratur; untuk angka saat ini, konsultasikan laporan lelang PJM yang diposting dan docket komisi negara bagian Anda.

segments.src: Bill impact ranges are estimates and will differ by utility, zone, and service class.
segments.tr: Kisaran dampak tagihan adalah perkiraan dan akan berbeda menurut utilitas, zona, dan kelas layanan.

segments.src: This is general information, not investment or legal advice.*
segments.tr: Ini adalah informasi umum, bukan saran investasi atau hukum.*

ja.title: 電気料金の一部がAI料金に：米国のデータセンターブームの価格を決めるオークションの舞台裏

segments.src: Most people will never read a capacity auction report.
segments.tr: ほとんどの人は、容量オークションの報告書を読むことはないでしょう。

segments.src: But if you live in one of the 13 states or the District of Columbia served by the PJM Interconnection — roughly 65 million people, from Chicago to Newark to Richmond — one line in that report has more influence over your next electricity bill than almost anything happening in your own house.
segments.tr: しかし、PJMインターコネクションが提供する13州またはコロンビア特別区に住んでいるなら（シカゴからニューアーク、リッチモンドまで約6,500万人の人々）、その報告書の一行が、自宅で起きているほぼすべてのことよりも、次回の電気料金に大きな影響を与えます。

segments.src: That line is the clearing price.
segments.tr: その一行とは、「クリアリング価格（落札価格）」のことです。

segments.src: For the delivery year that runs June 1, 2026 through May 31, 2027, it came in at **$329.17 per megawatt-day** — the effective ceiling allowed in the auction.
segments.tr: 2026年6月1日から2027年5月31日までを対象とする供給年度において、その価格は**1メガワット日あたり329.17ドル**となりました。これはオークションで許可された実質的な上限価格です。

segments.src: Two delivery years earlier, the comparable price was **$28.92**.
segments.tr: その2年前の供給年度における同等の価格は**28.92ドル**でした。

segments.src: That is not a typo, and it is not inflation.
segments.tr: これは誤植ではなく、インフレによるものでもありません。

segments.src: It is the price of promising that the lights stay on in a grid where demand has started growing again after roughly two decades of sitting flat — and where the fastest-growing single category of new demand is the data center.
segments.tr: それは、約20年間の横ばい状態を経て需要が再び成長し始めたグリッドにおいて、そして新需要のなかで最も急速に成長している単一カテゴリーがデータセンターである状況下で、電灯を点灯させ続けることを約束する価格なのです。

segments.src: ## The three numbers that tell the story
segments.tr: ## 物語を物語る3つの数字

segments.src: | Delivery year | RTO-wide clearing price | Approximate total capacity cost |
segments.tr: | 供給年度 | RTO全体のクリアリング価格 | おおよその総容量コスト |

segments.src: | 2026 / 2027 | $329.17 per MW-day (at the cap) | ~$16.1 billion |
segments.tr: | 2026 / 2027 | MW日あたり329.17ドル（上限価格） | 約161億ドル |

segments.src: The 2026/27 auction, whose results PJM published in late July 2025, secured roughly 134,300 megawatts of capacity — a reserve margin somewhere near 19%, comfortably above the target.
segments.tr: PJMが2025年7月下旬に発表した2026/27年度のオークション結果では、約134,300メガワットの容量が確保されました。これは予備率が19%前後であり、目標値を十分に上回っています。

segments.src: In other words, the system did not come up short.
segments.tr: 言い換えれば、システムが不足したわけではありません。

segments.src: It simply became far more expensive to keep it that way.
segments.tr: 単に、それを維持するためのコストがはるかに高くなっただけです。

segments.src: ## What a capacity auction actually is
segments.tr: ## 容量オークションとは実際になにか

segments.src: This is the part that gets skipped, and it is the part that matters.
segments.tr: ここは省略されがちな部分ですが、最も重要な部分です。

segments.src: Electricity markets pay for two different things.
segments.tr: 電力市場では、2つの異なるものに対して支払いが行われます。

segments.src: One is **energy** — the actual kilowatt-hours you use, priced more or less continuously.
segments.tr: 一つは**エネルギー**です。これは実際に使用したキロワット時であり、ほぼ継続的に価格が決まります。

segments.src: The other is **capacity** — a standing commitment from a power plant, a demand-response aggregator, or a battery to be available and deliver during the worst hours of the year: the January morning when everything is frozen, the July afternoon when everything is running.
segments.tr: もう一つは**容量（キャパシティ）**です。これは、発電所、デマンドレスポンス・アグリゲーター、または蓄電池が、年で最も過酷な時間帯（すべてが凍りつく1月の朝や、すべてがフル稼働する7月の午後）に利用可能であり、電力を供給できるという常設のコミットメントです。

segments.src: PJM buys that commitment years ahead through the Base Residual Auction.
segments.tr: PJMは、ベース・レジデュアル・オークションを通じて、数年前からそのコミットメントを購入します。

segments.src: Suppliers offer to be available; PJM buys until it has enough to meet a reliability requirement; and — this is the crucial mechanic — **every cleared supplier gets paid the same clearing price**, set by the most expensive offer needed to fill the requirement.
segments.tr: 供給業者が利用可能であることを申し出、PJMは信頼性要件を満たすのに十分な量を購入します。そして、ここが重要なメカニズムなのですが、**落札したすべての供給業者は、要件を満たすために必要だった最も高価な申し出によって設定された同一のクリアリング価格で支払われます**。

segments.src: Not their own asking price.
segments.tr: 彼ら自身の希望価格ではありません。

segments.src: The market price.
segments.tr: 市場価格です。

segments.src: That single design choice is why the number moves so violently.
segments.tr: この単一の設計上の選択が、数字を激しく変動させる理由です。

segments.src: When the requirement rises past the cheap, already-built supply and starts reaching into the expensive tail of the offer stack, the price for *everything* resets upward at once.
segments.tr: 要件が安価で既に構築済みの供給量を超え、申し出スタックの高価な末端に達し始めると、*すべて*の価格が一斉に上方へリセットされます。

segments.src: A modest increase in demand can produce a very immodest increase in cost.
segments.tr: 需要のわずかな増加が、コストの非常に大幅な増加をもたらす可能性があります。

segments.src: Then the cost gets spread.
segments.tr: その後、そのコストは分散されます。

segments.src: Utilities buy capacity on behalf of their customers and pass the charge through — showing up in the supply or generation portion of your bill, in your state's price-to-compare, or in a competitive supplier's rate.
segments.tr: 公益事業者は顧客に代わって容量を購入し、その料金を転嫁します。これは、請求書の供給または発電部分、州の比較価格、または競争力のある供給業者の料金率に現れます。

segments.src: You never see a line item called "capacity auction."
segments.tr: 請求書に「容量オークション」という項目が表示されることはありません。

segments.src: You just see a bigger number.
segments.tr: ただ、数字が大きくなっているのが見えるだけです。

segments.src: ## Why the price hit the ceiling
segments.tr: ## なぜ価格が上限に達したのか

segments.src: Three pressures arrived at the same time.
segments.tr: 3つの圧力が同時に押し寄せました。

segments.src: **Supply left.** Coal and older oil- and gas-fired units have been retiring on economics, age, and environmental compliance schedules.
segments.tr: **供給の減少。** 石炭火力や古い石油・ガス火力ユニットは、経済性、経年劣化、および環境コンプライアンスのスケジュールに従って引退しています。

segments.src: Once a plant deactivates, its capacity stops showing up in the auction.
segments.tr: 発電所が停止すると、その容量はオークションに現れなくなります。

segments.src: **Replacement is slow.** New solar, wind, storage, and gas projects have to clear interconnection studies, permitting, local approval, financing, and equipment orders.
segments.tr: **代替の遅れ。** 新しい太陽光、風力、蓄電、およびガスプロジェクトは、相互接続調査、許認可、地域住民の承認、資金調達、および設備注文をクリアしなければなりません。

segments.src: PJM's queue holds a very large volume of proposed projects; the constraint is not developer interest but the pace of study, construction, and delivery.
segments.tr: PJMのキュー（待機列）には非常に多くの提案プロジェクトがありますが、制約となっているのは開発者の関心ではなく、調査、建設、および納入のペースです。

segments.src: Heavy-duty gas turbines in particular are effectively sold out well into the next decade, with order backlogs at the handful of firms that build them.
segments.tr: 特に大型ガスタービンは、それを製造する数少ない企業の受注残により、次の10年まで実質的に完売状態にあります。

segments.src: **Demand turned upward.** After years of flat load, PJM's forecasts now show substantial peak growth through 2030 — the sharpest revision the region has seen in a generation.
segments.tr: **需要の増加。** 長年の負荷横ばい後、PJMの予測では、2030年まで大幅なピーク成長が見込まれています。これはこの地域で一世代ぶりに見られる急激な修正です。

segments.src: Electrification contributes.
segments.tr: 電化が寄与しています。

segments.src: Manufacturing contributes.
segments.tr: 製造業が寄与しています。

segments.src: But the category driving the revision is large data-center load, concentrated heavily in Northern Virginia and spreading into Ohio, Pennsylvania, Indiana, and Maryland.
segments.tr: しかし、この修正を牽引しているカテゴリーは大規模なデータセンターの負荷であり、バージニア州北部に集中し、オハイオ州、ペンシルベニア州、インディアナ州、メリーランド州へと広がっています。

segments.src: Retirements plus slow replacement plus rising demand equals a tighter requirement met by a more expensive offer stack.
segments.tr: 引退 ＋ 代替の遅れ ＋ 需要の増加 ＝ より高価な申し出スタックによって満たされる、より厳しい要件、ということになります。

segments.src: The auction did what it was designed to do: it printed a very loud price signal.
segments.tr: オークションは設計通りに機能しました。つまり、非常に強力な価格シグナルを発信したのです。

segments.src: ## How much of this is really AI?
segments.tr: ## このうち、実際にはどれだけがAIによるものか？

segments.src: Here the honest answer requires care, because this is where public discussion tends to get sloppy.
segments.tr: ここでの正直な答えには注意が必要です。なぜなら、こここそが公的な議論が曖昧になりがちな部分だからです。

segments.src: PJM's independent market monitor, which analyzes the auction separately from PJM itself, has published assessments attributing the large majority of the recent price increases to growth in large load — data centers above all.
segments.tr: PJMとは別にオークションを分析しているPJMの独立市場監視機関は、最近の価格上昇の大部分が大規模負荷の増加、とりわけデータセンターによるものであるとする評価を公表しています。

segments.src: Under that analysis, if data-center demand growth were removed from the reliability requirement, the clearing price would be dramatically lower.
segments.tr: その分析によれば、もし信頼性要件からデータセンターの需要増加を除外すれば、クリアリング価格は劇的に低くなっていたはずです。

segments.src: That is a modeled counterfactual, not a measurement, and reasonable analysts dispute the exact share.
segments.tr: これはモデル化された反実仮想であり、測定値ではありません。妥当な分析者の間でも正確な割合については意見が分かれています。

segments.src: But the direction is not seriously contested: data centers are the dominant swing factor.
segments.tr: しかし、方向性については深刻な異論はありません。データセンターが支配的な変動要因であるということです。

segments.src: Two fair counterpoints belong alongside it.
segments.tr: これに併せて、2つの公正な反論を挙げるべきでしょう。

segments.src: First, data centers do pay.
segments.tr: 第一に、データセンターも支払っています。

segments.src: They pay retail tariffs, they pay capacity charges proportional to their contribution to peak, and in many cases they pay for interconnection upgrades directly.
segments.tr: 彼らは小売料金を支払い、ピークへの寄与分に応じた容量料金を支払い、多くの場合、相互接続のアップグレード費用を直接支払っています。

segments.src: They are not receiving free electricity.
segments.tr: 彼らが無料で電気を受け取っているわけではありません。

segments.src: Second, the grievance is about **allocation and risk**, not theft.
segments.tr: 第二に、不満の正体は盗みではなく、**配分とリスク**についてです。

segments.src: When a uniform clearing price resets because one customer class is adding gigawatts, every other customer — the household, the school district, the machine shop — pays the new price on their existing consumption too.
segments.tr: ある顧客クラスがギガワット単位で負荷を追加したために一律のクリアリング価格がリセットされると、他のすべての顧客（家庭、学区、機械工作所）も、既存の消費量に対して新しい価格を支払うことになります。

segments.src: The build-out's cost is socialized across the whole footprint, while the revenue from the build-out is not.
segments.tr: 構築コストは全地域で社会化（分散）されますが、構築から得られる収益はそうではありません。

segments.src: That asymmetry, rather than any single company's behavior, is the actual policy problem.
segments.tr: 単一の企業の行動ではなく、この非対称性こそが実際の政策上の問題なのです。

segments.src: ## What this looks like on your bill
segments.tr: ## 請求書にどのように現れるか

segments.src: PJM's own estimate for the 2026/27 result was an increase in the range of roughly **1.5% to 5% on typical residential bills**, varying by zone — layered on top of the considerably larger increase already working its way through from the prior auction.
segments.tr: PJMによる2026/27年度の結果の推定では、ゾーンによって異なりますが、**一般的な家庭用請求書で約1.5%から5%の増加**になるとされており、これは前回のオークションから既に適用されつつあるかなり大きな増加に上乗せされる形になります。

segments.src: Several things make the lived experience messier than that range suggests:
segments.tr: 実際の体験は、この範囲よりも複雑になるいくつかの要因があります。

segments.src: - **Timing varies.** States and utilities procure default supply on different cycles, so the same auction lands in different months and different chunks depending on where you live.
segments.tr: - **タイミングの変動。** 州や公益事業者がデフォルトの供給を調達するサイクルが異なるため、同じオークション結果が住んでいる場所によって異なる月や異なるタイミングで反映されます。

segments.src: - **Zones differ.** Transmission constraints mean some areas clear above the RTO-wide price, and those customers absorb more.
segments.tr: - **ゾーンの違い。** 送電制約があるため、一部の地域ではRTO全体の価格を上回る価格で落札され、それらの顧客がより多くのコストを負担します。

segments.src: - **Capacity is only part of the bill.** Transmission investment, distribution rates, and fuel costs move on their own schedules and can pull the total in the same direction at the same time.
segments.tr: - **容量は請求書の一部に過ぎない。** 送電投資、配電料金、燃料費は独自のスケジュールで変動し、同時に合計金額を同じ方向に押し上げる可能性があります。

segments.src: If you want your actual number rather than an average, the practical path is your utility's rate filing or price-to-compare notice at your state public utility commission — that document shows the supply cost being passed through, in your zone, for your service class.
segments.tr: 平均ではなく実際の数字を知りたい場合は、公益事業者が州の公共事業委員会に提出した料金申請書または比較価格通知を確認するのが現実的な方法です。その文書には、あなたのゾーン、あなたのサービスクラスに転嫁される供給コストが記載されています。

segments.src: ## Who is trying to fix it, and how
segments.tr: ## 誰がどのように解決しようとしているか

segments.src: The response has been unusually fast by energy-regulation standards.
segments.tr: エネルギー規制の基準からすると、対応は異例に速いものでした。

segments.src: **A price collar.** After Pennsylvania's governor challenged the auction rules at the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, PJM and the state reached a settlement that FERC approved: a floor and a ceiling on the clearing price for the 2026/27 and 2027/28 auctions.
segments.tr: **価格カラー（価格帯制限）。** ペンシルベニア州知事が連邦エネルギー規制委員会（FERC）にオークション規則に異議を唱えた後、PJMと州はFERCが承認した合意に達しました。それは、2026/27年度および2027/28年度のオークションのクリアリング価格に下限と上限を設けることでした。

segments.src: The ceiling is precisely why 2026/27 stopped at $329.17.
segments.tr: 2026/27年度が329.17ドルで止まったのは、まさにこの上限があるためです。

segments.src: Absent that cap, the price would very likely have gone higher — a detail worth remembering when reading the number.
segments.tr: この上限がなければ、価格はさらに高くなっていた可能性が非常に高く、数字を読む際に覚えておくべき詳細です。

segments.src: **Faster interconnection for what's needed.** PJM created a fast-track pathway to move a limited slate of projects that add reliable capacity quickly, alongside broader reforms to its interconnection process.
segments.tr: **必要なものの相互接続の高速化。** PJMは、相互接続プロセスの広範な改革と併せて、信頼できる容量を迅速に追加する限定的なプロジェクト群を優先的に進めるファストトラック経路を設けました。

segments.src: **Making large loads carry their own weight.** This is the most consequential front.
segments.tr: **大規模負荷に自らの責任を持たせる。** これが最も影響力の大きい局面です。

segments.src: Regulators and utilities across the footprint are reworking how very large customers are treated: minimum-demand contracts so a data center pays for most of the capacity it reserves whether or not it uses it, separate rate classes for large loads, collateral and exit provisions, and rules for "bring your own generation" or co-located supply arrangements.
segments.tr: 地域全体の規制当局と公益事業者は、超大規模顧客の扱い方を再検討しています。データセンターが使用するかどうかにかかわらず、予約した容量の大部分に対して支払う最低需要契約、大規模負荷向けの別料金クラス、担保および退出条項、そして「自家発電の持ち込み」や共同設置供給 arrangement に関する規則などです。

segments.src: Ohio approved a large-load framework along these lines, and similar proceedings have opened elsewhere.
segments.tr: オハイオ州はこの方針に沿った大規模負荷フレームワークを承認し、同様の手続きが他の場所でも始まっています。

segments.src: FERC has taken up the co-location question for PJM specifically.
segments.tr: FERCは、特にPJMにおける共同設置の問題を取り上げています。

segments.src: **Demand flexibility.** Because the requirement is driven by a handful of peak hours, a data center willing to curtail or shift to on-site generation during those hours reduces the requirement itself.
segments.tr: **需要の柔軟性。** 要件が少数のピーク時間帯によって決定されるため、それらの時間帯に制限またはオンサイト発電への切り替えを承諾するデータセンターは、要件そのものを減少させます。

segments.src: Several operators have signaled willingness; turning that into enforceable, verifiable commitments is the unfinished work.
segments.tr: いくつかの事業者は意向を示していますが、それを執行可能で検証可能なコミットメントに変えることが未完了の課題です。

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 次に注目すべき点

segments.src: - **Subsequent auction results.** Each new Base Residual Auction tests whether new supply and demand-side commitments are arriving fast enough to pull the price off the ceiling — and what happens when the collar's coverage ends.
segments.tr: - **今後のオークション結果。** 新しいベース・レジデュアル・オークションが行われるたびに、新しい供給と需要側のコミットメントが、価格を上限から引き下げるのに十分な速さで導入されているかが試されます。また、カラーの適用期間が終わったときに何が起きるかも注目です。

segments.src: - **Whether large-load tariffs actually bind.** A rate class only shifts cost if its minimum-take and collateral terms survive negotiation and litigation intact.
segments.tr: - **大規模負荷料金が実際に拘束力を持つか。** 料金クラスは、その最低受電量と担保条件が交渉や訴訟を経てそのまま維持される場合にのみ、コストを転嫁できます。

segments.src: - **Real megawatts, not announcements.** Announced generation projects are cheap; steel in the ground and turbines delivered are what changes an auction outcome.
segments.tr: - **発表ではなく、実際のメガワット。** 発表された発電プロジェクトは安上がりです。実際に地面に鋼材が打ち込まれ、タービンが納入されてこそ、オークションの結果が変わります。

segments.src: - **Whether load forecasts hold.** Some share of the interconnection requests in the pipeline is speculative or duplicated across utilities. If forecast demand is revised down, the requirement — and the price — follows.
segments.tr: - **負荷予測が維持されるか。** パイプラインにある相互接続リクエストの一部は投機的であったり、複数の公益事業者に重複して申請されていたりします。予測需要が下方修正されれば、要件、そして価格もそれに伴って下がります。

segments.src: - **Political durability.** Rate increases of this size tend to outlast the technical debate. Legislative intervention in individual states is a live possibility.
segments.tr: - **政治的な持続可能性。** この規模の料金値上げは、技術的な議論を乗り越えて存続する傾向があります。個別の州での立法的な介入の可能性は十分にあります。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: The AI build-out has a price, and part of it is being paid through an obscure auction that most ratepayers have never heard of.
segments.tr: AIの構築にはコストがかかり、その一部は、ほとんどの料金支払者が聞いたこともないような曖昧なオークションを通じて支払われています。

segments.src: There is nothing hidden or improper about the mechanism — the rules are public, the results are published, and the market is doing exactly what a uniform-clearing-price market does when demand outruns cheap supply.
segments.tr: このメカニズムに隠されたことや不適切なことは何もありません。ルールは公開されており、結果も公表され、市場は需要が安価な供給を上回ったときに一律クリアリング価格市場が行うことを正確に行っています。

segments.src: What is genuinely unresolved is who should bear the cost.
segments.tr: 本当に未解決なのは、誰がそのコストを負担すべきかということです。

segments.src: Right now the answer is largely "everyone on the system, in proportion to their existing usage."
segments.tr: 現在の答えは、主に「システム上のすべての人、既存の使用量に比例して」となっています。

de.title: Ihre Stromrechnung ist nun teilweise eine KI-Rechnung: Ein Blick in die Auktion, die den Boom der Rechenzentren in Amerika bepreist

segments.src: Most people will never read a capacity auction report.
segments.tr: Die meisten Menschen werden niemals einen Bericht über eine Kapazitätsauktion lesen.

segments.src: But if you live in one of the 13 states or the District of Columbia served by the PJM Interconnection — roughly 65 million people, from Chicago to Newark to Richmond — one line in that report has more influence over your next electricity bill than almost anything happening in your own house.
segments.tr: Aber wenn Sie in einem der 13 Bundesstaaten oder im District of Columbia leben, die vom PJM Interconnection versorgt werden — etwa 65 Millionen Menschen, von Chicago über Newark bis Richmond — hat eine einzige Zeile in diesem Bericht mehr Einfluss auf Ihre nächste Stromrechnung als fast alles, was in Ihrem eigenen Haus passiert.

segments.src: That line is the clearing price.
segments.tr: Diese Zeile ist der Clearing-Preis.

segments.src: For the delivery year that runs June 1, 2026 through May 31, 2027, it came in at **$329.17 per megawatt-day** — the effective ceiling allowed in the auction.
segments.tr: Für das Lieferjahr vom 1. Juni 2026 bis zum 31. Mai 2027 lag er bei **329,17 $ pro Megawatt-Tag** — die effektive Obergrenze, die in der Auktion zulässig war.

segments.src: Two delivery years earlier, the comparable price was **$28.92**.
segments.tr: Zwei Lieferjahre zuvor lag der vergleichbare Preis bei **28,92 $**.

segments.src: That is not a typo, and it is not inflation.
segments.tr: Das ist kein Tippfehler und es ist auch keine Inflation.

segments.src: It is the price of promising that the lights stay on in a grid where demand has started growing again after roughly two decades of sitting flat — and where the fastest-growing single category of new demand is the data center.
segments.tr: Es ist der Preis für das Versprechen, dass das Licht anbleibt in einem Netz, in dem die Nachfrage nach etwa zwei Jahrzehnten der Stagnation wieder zu wachsen begonnen hat — und in dem die am schnellsten wachsende einzelne Kategorie der neuen Nachfrage das Rechenzentrum ist.

segments.src: ## The three numbers that tell the story
segments.tr: ## Die drei Zahlen, die die Geschichte erzählen

segments.tr: | Lieferjahr | RTO-weiter Clearing-Preis | Ungefähre Gesamtkapazitätskosten |
| 2024 / 2025 | 28,92 $ pro MW-Tag | ~2,2 Milliarden $ |
| 2025 / 2026 | 269,92 $ pro MW-Tag | ~14,7 Milliarden $ |

segments.src: The 2026/27 auction, whose results PJM published in late July 2025, secured roughly 134,300 megawatts of capacity — a reserve margin somewhere near 19%, comfortably above the target.
segments.tr: Die Auktion 2026/27, deren Ergebnisse PJM Ende Juli 2025 veröffentlichte, sicherte etwa 134.300 Megawatt an Kapazität — eine Reservemarge von etwa 19 %, was deutlich über dem Zielwert liegt.

segments.src: In other words, the system did not come up short.
segments.tr: Mit anderen Worten, dem System fehlte es nicht an Kapazität.

segments.src: It simply became far more expensive to keep it that way.
segments.tr: Es wurde lediglich weitaus teurer, es so zu halten.

segments.src: ## What a capacity auction actually is
segments.tr: ## Was eine Kapazitätsauktion eigentlich ist

segments.src: This is the part that gets skipped, and it is the part that matters.
segments.tr: Dies ist der Teil, der oft übersprungen wird, und es ist der Teil, der zählt.

segments.src: Electricity markets pay for two different things.
segments.tr: Strommärkte bezahlen zwei verschiedene Dinge.

segments.src: One is **energy** — the actual kilowatt-hours you use, priced more or less continuously.
segments.tr: Das eine ist **Energie** — die tatsächlichen Kilowattstunden, die Sie verbrauchen, deren Preis mehr oder weniger kontinuierlich festgelegt wird.

segments.src: The other is **capacity** — a standing commitment from a power plant, a demand-response aggregator, or a battery to be available and deliver during the worst hours of the year: the January morning when everything is frozen, the July afternoon when everything is running.
segments.tr: Das andere ist **Kapazität** — eine dauerhafte Verpflichtung eines Kraftwerks, eines Demand-Response-Aggregators oder einer Batterie, in den kritischsten Stunden des Jahres verfügbar zu sein und Strom zu liefern: am Januarmorgen, wenn alles gefroren ist, oder am Julinachmittag, wenn alles läuft.

segments.src: PJM buys that commitment years ahead through the Base Residual Auction.
segments.tr: PJM kauft diese Verpflichtung Jahre im Voraus über die Base Residual Auction.

segments.src: Suppliers offer to be available; PJM buys until it has enough to meet a reliability requirement; and — this is the crucial mechanic — **every cleared supplier gets paid the same clearing price**, set by the most expensive offer needed to fill the requirement.
segments.tr: Anbieter bieten ihre Verfügbarkeit an; PJM kauft, bis es genügend hat, um eine Zuverlässigkeitsanforderung zu erfüllen; und — dies ist der entscheidende Mechanismus — **jeder zugelassene Anbieter erhält den gleichen Clearing-Preis**, der durch das teuerste Angebot bestimmt wird, das zur Erfüllung der Anforderung benötigt wird.

segments.src: Not their own asking price.
segments.tr: Nicht ihren eigenen geforderten Preis.

segments.src: The market price.
segments.tr: Sondern den Marktpreis.

segments.src: That single design choice is why the number moves so violently.
segments.tr: Diese eine Designentscheidung ist der Grund, warum die Zahl so heftig schwankt.

segments.src: When the requirement rises past the cheap, already-built supply and starts reaching into the expensive tail of the offer stack, the price for *everything* resets upward at once.
segments.tr: Wenn die Anforderung über das günstige, bereits bestehende Angebot hinaussteigt und in den teuren Bereich des Angebotsstapels reicht, wird der Preis für *alles* gleichzeitig nach oben korrigiert.

segments.src: A modest increase in demand can produce a very immodest increase in cost.
segments.tr: Ein bescheidener Anstieg der Nachfrage kann zu einem sehr unbescheidenen Anstieg der Kosten führen.

segments.src: Then the cost gets spread.
segments.tr: Dann werden die Kosten verteilt.

segments.src: Utilities buy capacity on behalf of their customers and pass the charge through — showing up in the supply or generation portion of your bill, in your state's price-to-compare, or in a competitive supplier's rate.
segments.tr: Versorgungsunternehmen kaufen Kapazität im Namen ihrer Kunden und geben die Gebühren weiter — sie erscheinen im Versorgungs- oder Erzeugungsanteil Ihrer Rechnung, im Vergleichspreis Ihres Bundesstaates oder im Tarif eines wettbewerbsfähigen Anbieters.

segments.src: You never see a line item called "capacity auction."
segments.tr: Sie sehen niemals einen Posten namens "Kapazitätsauktion".

segments.src: You just see a bigger number.
segments.tr: Sie sehen einfach nur eine höhere Zahl.

segments.src: ## Why the price hit the ceiling
segments.tr: ## Warum der Preis die Obergrenze erreichte

segments.src: Three pressures arrived at the same time.
segments.tr: Drei Druckfaktoren traten gleichzeitig auf.

segments.src: **Supply left.** Coal and older oil- and gas-fired units have been retiring on economics, age, and environmental compliance schedules.
segments.tr: **Das Angebot sank.** Kohle sowie ältere Öl- und Gasanlagen wurden aus wirtschaftlichen Gründen, wegen ihres Alters oder aufgrund von Umweltauflagen stillgelegt.

segments.src: Once a plant deactivates, its capacity stops showing up in the auction.
segments.tr: Sobald ein Kraftwerk deaktiviert wird, erscheint seine Kapazität nicht mehr in der Auktion.

segments.src: **Replacement is slow.** New solar, wind, storage, and gas projects have to clear interconnection studies, permitting, local approval, financing, and equipment orders.
segments.tr: **Der Ersatz erfolgt langsam.** Neue Solar-, Wind-, Speicher- und Gasprojekte müssen Netzanschlussstudien, Genehmigungen, lokale Zustimmungen, Finanzierungen und Gerätebestellungen durchlaufen.

segments.src: PJM's queue holds a very large volume of proposed projects; the constraint is not developer interest but the pace of study, construction, and delivery.
segments.tr: Die Warteschlange von PJM enthält ein sehr großes Volumen an vorgeschlagenen Projekten; die Einschränkung ist nicht das Interesse der Entwickler, sondern das Tempo der Prüfung, des Baus und der Lieferung.

segments.src: Heavy-duty gas turbines in particular are effectively sold out well into the next decade, with order backlogs at the handful of firms that build them.
segments.tr: Insbesondere Hochleistungsgasturbinen sind effektiv bis weit in das nächste Jahrzehnt ausverkauft, mit enormen Auftragsrückständen bei den wenigen Firmen, die sie bauen.

segments.src: **Demand turned upward.** After years of flat load, PJM's forecasts now show substantial peak growth through 2030 — the sharpest revision the region has seen in a generation.
segments.tr: **Die Nachfrage stieg an.** Nach Jahren stagnierender Last zeigen die Prognosen von PJM nun ein erhebliches Spitzenwachstum bis 2030 — die schärfste Revision, die die Region seit einer Generation erlebt hat.

segments.src: Electrification contributes.
segments.tr: Die Elektrifizierung trägt dazu bei.

segments.src: Manufacturing contributes.
segments.tr: Die Fertigungsindustrie trägt dazu bei.

segments.src: But the category driving the revision is large data-center load, concentrated heavily in Northern Virginia and spreading into Ohio, Pennsylvania, Indiana, and Maryland.
segments.tr: Aber die Kategorie, die die Revision vorantreibt, ist die Last großer Rechenzentren, die sich stark in Nord-Virginia konzentriert und sich nach Ohio, Pennsylvania, Indiana und Maryland ausbreitet.

segments.src: Retirements plus slow replacement plus rising demand equals a tighter requirement met by a more expensive offer stack.
segments.tr: Stilllegungen plus langsamer Ersatz plus steigende Nachfrage gleich eine engere Anforderung, die durch einen teureren Angebotsstapel erfüllt wird.

segments.src: The auction did what it was designed to do: it printed a very loud price signal.
segments.tr: Die Auktion tat das, wofür sie konzipiert wurde: Sie sendete ein sehr deutliches Preissignal.

segments.src: ## How much of this is really AI?
segments.tr: ## Wie viel davon ist wirklich KI?

segments.src: Here the honest answer requires care, because this is where public discussion tends to get sloppy.
segments.tr: Hier erfordert die ehrliche Antwort Sorgfalt, da dies der Punkt ist, an dem die öffentliche Diskussion oft ungenau wird.

segments.src: PJM's independent market monitor, which analyzes the auction separately from PJM itself, has published assessments attributing the large majority of the recent price increases to growth in large load — data centers above all.
segments.tr: Der unabhängige Marktüberwacher von PJM, der die Auktion getrennt von PJM selbst analysiert, hat Bewertungen veröffentlicht, die den Großteil der jüngsten Preissteigerungen dem Wachstum großer Lasten — vor allem Rechenzentren — zuschreiben.

segments.src: Under that analysis, if data-center demand growth were removed from the reliability requirement, the clearing price would be dramatically lower.
segments.tr: Nach dieser Analyse wäre der Clearing-Preis dramatisch niedriger, wenn das Nachfragewachstum der Rechenzentren aus der Zuverlässigkeitsanforderung entfernt würde.

segments.src: That is a modeled counterfactual, not a measurement, and reasonable analysts dispute the exact share.
segments.tr: Dies ist ein modelliertes kontrafaktisches Szenario, keine Messung, und vernünftige Analysten streiten über den genauen Anteil.

segments.src: But the direction is not seriously contested: data centers are the dominant swing factor.
segments.tr: Aber die Richtung wird nicht ernsthaft bestritten: Rechenzentren sind der dominierende Faktor.

segments.src: Two fair counterpoints belong alongside it.
segments.tr: Zwei faire Gegenargumente gehören dazu.

segments.src: First, data centers do pay.
segments.tr: Erstens zahlen Rechenzentren.

segments.src: They pay retail tariffs, they pay capacity charges proportional to their contribution to peak, and in many cases they pay for interconnection upgrades directly.
segments.tr: Sie zahlen Einzelhandelstarife, sie zahlen Kapazitätsgebühren proportional zu ihrem Beitrag zur Spitzenlast und in vielen Fällen zahlen sie direkt für Netzanschluss-Upgrades.

segments.src: They are not receiving free electricity.
segments.tr: Sie erhalten keinen kostenlosen Strom.

segments.src: Second, the grievance is about **allocation and risk**, not theft.
segments.tr: Zweitens geht es bei der Beschwerde um **Zuweisung und Risiko**, nicht um Diebstahl.

segments.src: When a uniform clearing price resets because one customer class is adding gigawatts, every other customer — the household, the school district, the machine shop — pays the new price on their existing consumption too.
segments.tr: Wenn ein einheitlicher Clearing-Preis neu festgelegt wird, weil eine Kundenklasse Gigawatt hinzufügt, zahlt jeder andere Kunde — der Haushalt, der Schulbezirk, die Werkstatt — den neuen Preis auch für seinen bestehenden Verbrauch.

segments.src: The build-out's cost is socialized across the whole footprint, while the revenue from the build-out is not.
segments.tr: Die Kosten des Ausbaus werden über den gesamten Bereich sozialisiert, während die Einnahmen aus dem Ausbau dies nicht tun.

segments.src: That asymmetry, rather than any single company's behavior, is the actual policy problem.
segments.tr: Diese Asymmetrie, und nicht das Verhalten eines einzelnen Unternehmens, ist das eigentliche politische Problem.

segments.src: ## What this looks like on your bill
segments.tr: ## Wie sich das auf Ihrer Rechnung auswirkt

segments.src: PJM's own estimate for the 2026/27 result was an increase in the range of roughly **1.5% to 5% on typical residential bills**, varying by zone — layered on top of the considerably larger increase already working its way through from the prior auction.
segments.tr: PJMs eigene Schätzung für das Ergebnis 2026/27 war eine Erhöhung im Bereich von etwa **1,5 % bis 5 % auf typischen Wohnrechnungen**, je nach Zone — zusätzlich zu der bereits erheblich größeren Erhöhung, die aus der vorherigen Auktion resultiert.

segments.src: Several things make the lived experience messier than that range suggests:
segments.tr: Mehrere Faktoren machen die gelebte Erfahrung komplizierter, als dieser Bereich vermuten lässt:

segments.src: - **Timing varies.** States and utilities procure default supply on different cycles, so the same auction lands in different months and different chunks depending on where you live.
segments.tr: - **Das Timing variiert.** Bundesstaaten und Versorgungsunternehmen beschaffen die Standardversorgung in verschiedenen Zyklen, sodass dieselbe Auktion je nach Wohnort in verschiedenen Monaten und in verschiedenen Beträgen ankommt.

segments.src: - **Zones differ.** Transmission constraints mean some areas clear above the RTO-wide price, and those customers absorb more.
segments.tr: - **Zonen unterscheiden sich.** Übertragungsbeschränkungen bedeuten, dass einige Gebiete über dem RTO-weiten Preis liegen und diese Kunden mehr tragen.

segments.src: - **Capacity is only part of the bill.** Transmission investment, distribution rates, and fuel costs move on their own schedules and can pull the total in the same direction at the same time.
segments.tr: - **Kapazität ist nur ein Teil der Rechnung.** Investitionen in die Übertragung, Verteilertarife und Brennstoffkosten bewegen sich nach ihren eigenen Zeitplänen und können die Gesamtsumme gleichzeitig in dieselbe Richtung ziehen.

segments.src: If you want your actual number rather than an average, the practical path is your utility's rate filing or price-to-compare notice at your state public utility commission — that document shows the supply cost being passed through, in your zone, for your service class.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie Ihre tatsächliche Zahl statt eines Durchschnitts wissen möchten, ist der praktische Weg die Tarifanmeldung Ihres Versorgungsunternehmens oder die Mitteilung über den Vergleichspreis bei Ihrer staatlichen Kommission für öffentliche Versorgungsunternehmen — dieses Dokument zeigt die weitergegebenen Versorgungskosten in Ihrer Zone für Ihre Serviceklasse.

segments.src: ## Who is trying to fix it, and how
segments.tr: ## Wer versucht es zu beheben und wie

segments.src: The response has been unusually fast by energy-regulation standards.
segments.tr: Die Reaktion war nach Maßstäben der Energieregulierung ungewöhnlich schnell.

segments.src: **A price collar.** After Pennsylvania's governor challenged the auction rules at the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, PJM and the state reached a settlement that FERC approved: a floor and a ceiling on the clearing price for the 2026/27 and 2027/28 auctions.
segments.tr: **Ein Preiscollar.** Nachdem der Gouverneur von Pennsylvania die Auktionsregeln bei der Federal Energy Regulatory Commission angefochten hatte, einigten sich PJM und der Staat auf einen Vergleich, den die FERC genehmigte: eine Unter- und Obergrenze für den Clearing-Preis der Auktionen 2026/27 und 2027/28.

segments.src: The ceiling is precisely why 2026/27 stopped at $329.17.
segments.tr: Die Obergrenze ist genau der Grund, warum 2026/27 bei 329,17 $ stoppte.

segments.src: Absent that cap, the price would very likely have gone higher — a detail worth remembering when reading the number.
segments.tr: Ohne diese Deckelung wäre der Preis sehr wahrscheinlich höher gestiegen — ein Detail, das man sich beim Lesen der Zahl merken sollte.

segments.src: **Faster interconnection for what's needed.** PJM created a fast-track pathway to move a limited slate of projects that add reliable capacity quickly, alongside broader reforms to its interconnection process.
segments.tr: **Schnellere Netzanschlüsse für das Notwendige.** PJM hat einen Fast-Track-Pfad geschaffen, um eine begrenzte Anzahl von Projekten, die schnell zuverlässige Kapazität hinzufügen, voranzutreiben, zusammen mit umfassenderen Reformen seines Netzanschlussverfahrens.

segments.src: **Making large loads carry their own weight.** This is the most consequential front.
segments.tr: **Große Lasten dazu bringen, ihre eigene Last zu tragen.** Dies ist die folgenreichste Front.

segments.src: Regulators and utilities across the footprint are reworking how very large customers are treated: minimum-demand contracts so a data center pays for most of the capacity it reserves whether or not it uses it, separate rate classes for large loads, collateral and exit provisions, and rules for "bring your own generation" or co-located supply arrangements.
segments.tr: Regulierungsbehörden und Versorgungsunternehmen im gesamten Bereich überarbeiten die Behandlung sehr großer Kunden: Mindestbedarfverträge, sodass ein Rechenzentrum für den Großteil der Kapazität zahlt, die es reserviert, unabhängig davon, ob es sie nutzt oder nicht, separate Tarifklassen für große Lasten, Sicherheiten und Ausstiegsbestimmungen sowie Regeln für "Bring Your Own Generation" oder co-lokalisierte Versorgungsvereinbarungen.

segments.src: Ohio approved a large-load framework along these lines, and similar proceedings have opened elsewhere.
segments.tr: Ohio hat einen Rahmen für große Lasten in dieser Richtung genehmigt, und ähnliche Verfahren wurden anderswo eingeleitet.

segments.src: FERC has taken up the co-location question for PJM specifically.
segments.tr: Die FERC hat die Frage der Co-Lokalisierung speziell für PJM aufgegriffen.

segments.src: **Demand flexibility.** Because the requirement is driven by a handful of peak hours, a data center willing to curtail or shift to on-site generation during those hours reduces the requirement itself.
segments.tr: **Nachfrageflexibilität.** Da die Anforderung durch eine Handvoll von Spitzenstunden getrieben wird, reduziert ein Rechenzentrum, das bereit ist, in diesen Stunden den Verbrauch zu drosseln oder auf die eigene Erzeugung umzustellen, die Anforderung selbst.

segments.src: Several operators have signaled willingness; turning that into enforceable, verifiable commitments is the unfinished work.
segments.tr: Einige Betreiber haben ihre Bereitschaft signalisiert; dies in durchsetzbare, überprüfbare Verpflichtungen zu verwandeln, ist die noch nicht abgeschlossene Arbeit.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Worauf man als Nächstes achten sollte

segments.src: - **Subsequent auction results.** Each new Base Residual Auction tests whether new supply and demand-side commitments are arriving fast enough to pull the price off the ceiling — and what happens when the collar's coverage ends.
segments.tr: - **Ergebnisse nachfolgender Auktionen.** Jede neue Base Residual Auction testet, ob neue Angebots- und Nachfrageseitige Verpflichtungen schnell genug eintreffen, um den Preis von der Obergrenze zu drücken — und was passiert, wenn die Deckelung endet.

segments.src: - **Whether large-load tariffs actually bind.** A rate class only shifts cost if its minimum-take and collateral terms survive negotiation and litigation intact.
segments.tr: - **Ob Tarife für große Lasten tatsächlich binden.** Eine Tarifklasse verschiebt Kosten nur, wenn ihre Mindestabnahme- und Sicherheitsbestimmungen Verhandlungen und Rechtsstreitigkeiten unbeschadet überstehen.

segments.src: - **Real megawatts, not announcements.** Announced generation projects are cheap; steel in the ground and turbines delivered are what changes an auction outcome.
segments.tr: - **Echte Megawatt, keine Ankündigungen.** Angekündigte Erzeugungsprojekte sind billig; Stahl im Boden und gelieferte Turbinen sind das, was ein Auktionsergebnis verändert.

segments.src: - **Whether load forecasts hold.** Some share of the interconnection requests in the pipeline is speculative or duplicated across utilities. If forecast demand is revised down, the requirement — and the price — follows.
segments.tr: - **Ob Lastprognosen halten.** Ein Teil der in der Pipeline befindlichen Netzanschlussanfragen ist spekulativ oder wird über Versorgungsunternehmen hinweg dupliziert. Wenn die prognostizierte Nachfrage nach unten korrigiert wird, folgen die Anforderung — und der Preis.

segments.src: - **Political durability.** Rate increases of this size tend to outlast the technical debate. Legislative intervention in individual states is a live possibility.
segments.tr: - **Politische Beständigkeit.** Preiserhöhungen dieser Größenordnung neigen dazu, die technische Debatte zu überdauern. Gesetzgeberische Interventionen in einzelnen Bundesstaaten sind eine reale Möglichkeit.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: The AI build-out has a price, and part of it is being paid through an obscure auction that most ratepayers have never heard of.
segments.tr: Der Ausbau der KI hat einen Preis, und ein Teil davon wird über eine undurchsichtige Auktion bezahlt, von der die meisten Stromzahler noch nie gehört haben.

segments.src: There is nothing hidden or improper about the mechanism — the rules are public, the results are published, and the market is doing exactly what a uniform-clearing-price market does when demand outruns cheap supply.
segments.tr: Es gibt nichts Verstecktes oder Unangemessenes an dem Mechanismus — die Regeln sind öffentlich, die Ergebnisse werden veröffentlicht und der Markt tut genau das, was ein Markt mit einheitlichem Clearing-Preis tut, wenn die Nachfrage das günstige Angebot übersteigt.

segments.src: What is genuinely unresolved is who should bear the cost.
segments.tr: Was wirklich ungeklärt ist, ist, wer die Kosten tragen sollte.

segments.src: Right now the answer is largely "everyone on the system, in proportion to their existing usage."
segments.tr: Im Moment lautet die Antwort weitgehend: "alle im System, proportional zu ihrem bestehenden Verbrauch."

segments.src: Every reform currently in motion is an attempt to change that answer before the next several auctions lock it in.
segments.tr: Jede Reform, die derzeit im Gange ist, ist ein Versuch, diese Antwort zu ändern, bevor die nächsten Auktionen sie zementieren.

segments.src: *Figures in this article are drawn from PJM's published Base Residual Auction results, its independent market monitor's public analyses, and filings at FERC and state utility commissions.
segments.tr: *Die Zahlen in diesem Artikel stammen aus den veröffentlichten Ergebnissen der Base Residual Auction von PJM, den öffentlichen Analysen des unabhängigen Marktüberwachers und den Einreichungen bei der FERC und den staatlichen Versorgungsbehörden.

segments.src: Auction results and reform proceedings are updated regularly; for the current numbers, consult PJM's posted auction reports and your state commission's docket.
segments.tr: Auktionsergebnisse und Reformverfahren werden regelmäßig aktualisiert; für aktuelle Zahlen konsultieren Sie die veröffentlichten Auktionsberichte von PJM und das Register Ihrer staatlichen Kommission.

segments.src: Bill impact ranges are estimates and will differ by utility, zone, and service class.
segments.tr: Die Auswirkungen auf die Rechnung sind Schätzungen und variieren je nach Versorgungsunternehmen, Zone und Serviceklasse.
